runners.name: Westport
runners.spotlight: Comfortably defied a big penalty at Hamliton dropped to 5f, achieving the unusual feat of completing a novice treble; never figured in Royal Ascot handicap since, having been ridden further back than usual and met some traffic issues; with that defeat best forgiven, he remains of interest.
runners.comment: Completed a novice treble; best to forgive his Royal Ascot defeat; still of interest
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

runners.name: Comical Point
runners.spotlight: Consistent sort who has Listed/Group form; couple of good efforts since switched to handicap level, close second at Windsor latest; campaigned over 6f since last July but recorded his sole win (debut) over 5f; very solid claims, belatedly returned to this distance.
runners.comment: Consistent sort; raced mainly over 6f but gained sole win (debut) over 5f; solid

runners.name: Exclamation
runners.spotlight: Fairly useful on his day; good second over C&D last summer and made all at Chester this spring; has faced mostly difficult tasks otherwise this term but is the least solid contender on 2026 bare form; behind unexposed Westport at Royal Ascot.
runners.comment: Fairly useful on his day but is the least solid contender on 2026 bare form

runners.name: One And Gone
runners.spotlight: Generally consistent sort whose penultimate effort can be excused; made all in Class 4 contest at Goodwood (5f, good) last time, taking record to 2-14; back up two grades but receives weight all round and could go well; creditable third in sole C&D attempt.
runners.comment: Generally consistent; made all in lower grade at Goodwood last time; has C&D form

runners.name: Havana Hurricane
runners.spotlight: Useful and broadly consistent sprinter whose Listed/Group form includes a 2yo win at Royal Ascot; faced a stiffer task in the Commonwealth Cup back there last time; has earned top weight on handicap debut and looks one of the main players; wears first-time headgear.
runners.comment: Useful and broadly consistent sprinter; has earned top weight on handicap debut

runners.name: Miss Lizzy
runners.spotlight: Opened her account in AW contest; has appeared to run very well on the figures in two starts since, latest when 11th of 27 in the Queen Mary at Royal Ascot where she was the rank outsider; leading player provided that form is backed up.
runners.comment: Seemed to run well in the Queen Mary; leading player provided that form is backed up

runners.name: A Bear Affair
runners.spotlight: Brocklesby winner who appeared to run well in the Windsor Castle at Royal Ascot most recently; no certainty to back up that form, having posted his worst effort in C&D Listed event (behind Bill The Bull) on penultimate outing.
runners.comment: Appeared to run well at Royal Ascot; posted his worst effort in C&D event the time before
runners.owner: A Bit On The Side & Partner

runners.name: Bint Archange
runners.spotlight: Thrice-raced filly who finished last of 27 in the Queen Mary at Royal Ascot most recently, running poorly even allowing for a difficult task; however, the promise of her ready success over that C&D the time before is by no means forgotten.
runners.comment: Last of 27 in the Queen Mary but the promise of her Ascot win in May is not forgotten

runners.name: Bill The Bull
runners.spotlight: Ran well in C&D Listed contest on penultimate start, reversing Brocklesby placings with A Bear Affair, then made all in Bath maiden (5.7f, good) to become Adam Kirby's first 2yo winner as a trainer; has progressive RPRs and looks one for the shortlist.
runners.comment: Ran well in C&D Listed race prior to making all in Bath maiden; has progressive RPRs

runners.name: Ronson
runners.spotlight: The son of winners for his yard; has shown progressive form over 5f at Beverley, most recently going close in conditions race when a 50-1 shot despite scoring readily the time before; sire's good 2yo campaign featured a C&D Listed success; respected.
runners.comment: Has shown progressive form at Beverley; sire's 2yo campaign featured a C&D Listed success

runners.name: It Dunt Marra
runners.spotlight: Showed promise with second of five in 5f maiden at Goodwood; the bare form is well below Listed standard but he's open to progress; whether he can go one better at this level is another matter.
runners.comment: Showed promise with second of five in Goodwood maiden

runners.name: Underdog
runners.spotlight: Came up well short in the Norfolk at Royal Ascot but that assignment was probably too much too soon; comfortably made a winning debut in C&D contest (good) eight days earlier and looks interesting back in this scenario with progress still possible.
runners.comment: Scored comfortably over C&D on debut; came up well short at Royal Ascot eight days later

runners.name: Havana Flash
runners.spotlight: Sole newcomer in the field when appearing to need the outing in the Woodcote at Epsom; neck second dropped to 5f on the turf course at Lingfield later in June; may improve further but this seems a stiff task.
runners.comment: Neck second at Lingfield last time; may improve further but this seems a stiff task

runners.name: Cilician
runners.spotlight: Twice-raced gelding who has registered RPRs in the 80s by finishing a close second at Nottingham (good) then 11th of 21 in the Coventry at Royal Ascot (good to firm), both over 6f; leading form contender back down in class and upped in trip.
runners.comment: Has registered RPRs in the 80s over 6f, last time at Royal Ascot; leading form claims

runners.name: Encounter
runners.spotlight: Has shown clear promise in a couple of 7f maidens on good ground, latest at Sandown when doing well to finish a good third to Gymbaazy having stumbled amid traffic issues; gets a 5lb pull with that rival and may turn the tables provided this pans out better.
runners.comment: Did well to finish a good third to Gymbaazy over C&D last time, having met traffic issues

runners.name: Storm Blade
runners.spotlight: From a useful family that has served his connections well; showed signs of greenness on his way to finishing fourth of seven in 6f event on the turf course at Lingfield; open to improvement with the experience under his belt.
runners.comment: Showed signs of greenness on his way to finishing fourth of seven at Lingfield

runners.name: Dontlookbackinanga
runners.spotlight: 65,000euros foal, 92,000gns yearling; by Acclamation; sibling to five winners, notably Tabarrak (7f/1m including 2yo/Listed; RPR 117); dam 6f 2yo scorer (99); one of several newcomers in the field; market should be instructive.
runners.comment: 92,000gns yearling; by Acclamation; sibling to five winners; market informative

runners.name: Or Ever
runners.spotlight: Mehmas half-brother to 6f 2yo winner Kindergarten (RPR 90); dam unraced sister to 1m4f Group 3 winner/Melbourne Cup runner-up Tiger Moth, half-sister to 5f 2yo Listed scorer Coach House, out of 6f Group 3 winner; check the betting.
runners.comment: Mehmas half-brother to a 6f 2yo winner; check the betting

runners.name: The Balearic Sun
runners.spotlight: 300,000gns yearling; Lope De Vega half-brother to four winners, mostly useful or smart, notably Berkshire Rocco (7f-2m including 2yo/Listed; RPR 117); dam unplaced 1m AW (52); represents significant connections; interesting debutant.
runners.comment: 300,000gns yearling; nicely bred and represents significant connections; interesting

runners.name: Gymbaazy
runners.spotlight: Bred to be suited by 1m+ in due course; belied his 22-1 odds in seven-runner maiden over C&D on good ground, collaring the favourite in the final strides; one of the main players, even with a penalty, and should again finish his race well.
runners.comment: Collared the favourite in the final strides in C&D maiden; one of the main players

runners.name: My A'Ali Baba
runners.spotlight: Both starts over 6f on slow ground, winning at Chepstow then fifth of six (not disgraced on bare figures) at Goodwood; gelded since; faces a harder assignment in this field and pedigree gives mixed messages as regards the longer trip.
runners.comment: 6f winner who faces a stiffer task upped in distance; gelded since last run

runners.name: Beach Noir
runners.spotlight: 100,000euros yearling, 25,000gns (breeze-up) 2yo; Blackbeard half-brother to French 10.5f-1m4f winner Winema (including Listed; RPR 105); dam unraced half-sister to 9.5f Flat/2m hurdle winner Charlus; yard is 0-7 with 2yos this term.
runners.comment: 100,000euros yearling, 25,000gns (breeze-up) 2yo; yard is 0-7 with 2yos this term

runners.name: Walcourt
runners.spotlight: 56,000euros foal, 70,000euros yearling; by Churchill; sibling to four winners, including two in Britain, notably Sollertia (7f 2yo; RPR 84); dam 1m/8.4f scorer (including Listed; 98); stable has a modest strike-rate with 2yos.
runners.comment: 70,000euros yearling; by Churchill; stable has a modest strike-rate with 2yos

runners.name: Collateral Damage
runners.spotlight: Overcame apparent greenness in small-field maiden at Catterick (7f, good to soft) where he hung left and hampered the favourite on his way to prevailing by neck; open to progress but this is unquestionably a stiffer task under a penalty.
runners.comment: Overcame apparent greenness to prevail by neck at Catterick; this is harder

races.race_name: Davies Insurance Solutions Gala Stakes (Listed Race)

runners.name: Sallaal
runners.spotlight: Produced a very smart handicap performance at Epsom (1m2f, good to soft) on Oaks day, registering an RPR of 121 and taking record to 4-8; leading contender provided that form is backed up returned to Listed level.
runners.comment: Leading player provided the form of his impressive handicap win at Epsom is backed up

runners.name: Persica
runners.spotlight: Went close when bidding for a second win in the Diomed at Epsom and ties in closely with Dividend on the form of his respectable effort at Royal Ascot later in June; C&D winner on Eclipse day in 2024; possibilities.
runners.comment: Ties in closely with Dividend on Royal Ascot form; C&D winner on Eclipse day in 2024

runners.name: Boiling Point
runners.spotlight: Ran creditably, one place behind Persica, in Epsom Group 3 last time but is now worse off with that rival; has to overcome a 3lb penalty for narrow Listed win at Goodwood (1m2f, good) in May.
runners.comment: In form but has to overcome a penalty for narrow Listed win at Goodwood in May
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

runners.name: Glacius
runners.spotlight: Sole 3yo in this field and is open to further improvement; ran well behind Bow Echo in one of his 2yo races; good third in the Hampton Court at Royal Ascot (1m2f, good to firm; Group 3) on reappearance; adds interest.
runners.comment: Good third at Royal Ascot on reappearance; sole 3yo in this field and adds interest

runners.name: Dividend
runners.spotlight: In great form since wearing cheekpieces, completing a handicap double at Meydan then running well in better races, latest at Royal Ascot (1m2f, good to firm; Listed) back on home soil; solid claims in the retained headgear.
runners.comment: In great form since wearing cheekpieces; ran well at Royal Ascot most recently; solid

runners.name: Royal Rhyme
runners.spotlight: Hindered by major traffic issues when behind two of today's rivals at Royal Ascot last time; losing run is mounting up but he's 1-1 over C&D, namely a win in the 2024 Brigadier Gerard Stakes; interesting back here.
runners.comment: 1-1 over C&D, namely a win in the 2024 Brigadier Gerard Stakes; interesting back here
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

races.race_name: Coral Marathon (Listed Race) (Registered As The Esher Stakes)

runners.name: Lazy Griff
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in the Derby at Epsom last June and kept on well for third in the Irish Derby at the Curragh (also 1m4f on good) next time; showed he retains plenty of ability when a 2l third in C&D Group 3 in May (ahead of three of today's rivals), leaving the impression a stronger gallop would have suited; should come on for that first start in 11 months and looks the one to beat.
runners.comment: Placed in the Derby and Irish Derby last year; solid effort on his return over C&D

runners.name: Furthur
runners.spotlight: Both wins have been at Newbury, in a maiden over 1m3f last April and a Group 3 over 1m5f (good to firm) last August; respectable sixth in the St Leger in September but he's been below that level in all four starts since, including when beating only Duke Of Oxford home over this C&D in May; drops back to 2m having contested the Gold Cup two weeks ago.
runners.comment: Both wins at Newbury; respectable run in last year's St Leger but below that level since

runners.name: Duke Of Oxford
runners.spotlight: Eight-time AW winner, twice last winter in 2m handicaps at Kempton and Newcastle; however, he failed to beat a rival in a Group 3 over this C&D in May and has a bit to prove on turf (0-5).
runners.comment: Won twice on AW this winter; failed to beat a rival in C&D Group 3 latest; now 0-5 on turf
runners.owner: A Cope, B Roberts And J Biggane

runners.name: Paradias
runners.spotlight: Six-time winner on the Flat over shorter trips than this (1m1f-1m4f), including at this track in 2023; beaten about 5l when fifth of seven in a Group 3 over this C&D in May (behind Lazy Griff and ahead of Furthur and Duke Of Oxford) but that was steadily run and he didn't fully prove his stamina; stable won this with Trueshan in 2024 but this 7yo has a bit to find to reverse placings with Lazy Griff.
runners.comment: Six Flat wins have been over shorter trips; behind Lazy Griff in a C&D Group 3 in May

runners.name: Lady Vivian
runners.spotlight: 4yo filly whose two wins came last spring in a Southwell maiden (1m4f, AW) and Chester handicap (1m4f, good); struggled on soft ground in a 1m6f Listed race at Musselburgh this April and although she ran well when Listed fourth over 1m3f at Baden-Baden (good to soft) four weeks ago, she faded and didn't look to be crying out for this far; has a bit to find.
runners.comment: Won a maiden and handicap over 1m4f last year; doesn't look to be crying out for this far

runners.name: Marnier
runners.spotlight: Record is only 1-10, the success in AW maiden; however, shaped well in C&D handicap (good) most recently, staying on for third place in his first attempt beyond 1m4f; possibilities off current mark kept to this scenario.
runners.comment: Shaped well in C&D handicap (first attempt beyond 1m4f) last time; possibilities

runners.name: Aggagio
runners.spotlight: Ran creditably in sole Sandown attempt (four years ago) but is still seeking a first British Flat success away from Goodwood; modest third there last time in a race he'd won in 2022.
runners.comment: Still seeking first British Flat win away from Goodwood; modest third last time

runners.name: Macari
runners.spotlight: Creditable second in small field on penultimate start; successful over C&D (off 2lb lower) last July but wasn't in the same form returned to this scenario (behind two of today's rivals) in latest outing.
runners.comment: Scored over C&D last July; not in the same form back here in latest start
runners.owner: R Vaughan, R Bisiker, M Jones And S West

runners.name: Pyleates
runners.spotlight: Five-race maiden who was hindered by traffic issues over C&D (behind Marnier) most recently; has encouraging form otherwise and is bred to do better still, being a half-sister to three winners (including Group 1) for her connections; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Bred to do better still; hindered by traffic issues over C&D last time; shortlisted

runners.name: So Alex
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 4yo who has a largely solid record, including two AW wins under Billy Loughnane, since handicapping; good second in a couple of turf events this season, latest upped to 1m6f at Carlisle (good); his turn in this sphere looks near.
runners.comment: Good second in both starts this term, latest upped to 1m6f at Carlisle; respected

runners.name: Arqoob
runners.spotlight: Gained most recent win last August; below par in the latest of his two starts this term but is interesting on historical data, having defied a 2lb higher mark at Sandown on Eclipse day four years ago; drops in class.
runners.comment: Interesting on historical data, having won off 2lb higher at Sandown four years ago

runners.name: Minhad
runners.spotlight: Record is 2-10; gelded prior to success at Thirsk and respectable effort at York this term, both over 1m4f; still on career-high mark but ran well in sole 1m6f attempt and may be capable of another good run.
runners.comment: Has 1m4f form this term; still on career-high mark but ran well in sole 1m6f attempt

runners.name: Galactic Jack
runners.spotlight: Well treated on 2023 form but hasn't raced on the Flat for over two years and recent hurdles efforts suggest he's not the same horse now; needs to prove he retains peak ability.
runners.comment: Hasn't raced on Flat for over two years; recent hurdles form doesn't augur well

runners.name: Thursday Girl
runners.spotlight: Thrice-raced filly whose promise over 7f features second-place finishes at Newmarket (behind a useful sort) and Lingfield (AW) this term; may progress now handicapping, provided she stays the extra furlong; respected off bottom weight.
runners.comment: Has shown clear promise; may progress now handicapping; respected off bottom weight

runners.name: Ascending Star
runners.spotlight: Gelded prior to making all and turning over a 1-5 shot in novice event at Lingfield (7.5f, good) on stable/seasonal debut; may build on that win and improve further, having raced only three times; interesting handicap debutant.
runners.comment: Made all in Lingfield novice event on stable/seasonal debut; may improve further

runners.name: Cristo
runners.spotlight: Has broadly respectable form since returned to turf, notably a good effort behind Dovey Moon; however, still may be more interesting when back on Chelmsford AW; 2-2 there compared to 0-18 elsewhere.
runners.comment: Has respectable turf form but is still seeking first win away from Chelmsford

runners.name: Triple Double A
runners.spotlight: Scored off current mark on reappearance (1m2f, AW; in February) but hasn't been in the same form since, latterly back on turf, disappointing favourite returned to 1m most recently.
runners.comment: Scored off current mark on reappearance but hasn't been in the same form since

runners.name: Epictetus
runners.spotlight: Ran poorly last time; generally consistent otherwise this year, over a variety of trips, and may rebound; however, hasn't won for nearly three years and concedes weight all round in this field.
runners.comment: Hasn't won for nearly three years and concedes weight all round in this field

runners.name: Silca Bay
runners.spotlight: Three-time AW scorer at Kempton; opened his turf account in apprentice event under Oliver Carmichael at Goodwood (1m, good to soft) most recently; may remain competitive, back up just 2lb.
runners.comment: Opened his turf account in Goodwood event last time; may remain competitive

runners.name: H Key Lails
runners.spotlight: Consistent this year and recorded a clearcut win at Lingfield (7f, good) returned to turf last time but everything went his way (made all against favoured near rail); no certainty to defy a 6lb rise.
runners.comment: Everything went his way at Lingfield last time; no certainty to defy 6lb rise

runners.name: Amused
runners.spotlight: Ex-French 4yo who is 0-8 in Britain and not solid on 2026 form, with his second behind H Key Lails at Lingfield flanked by duck eggs; still has something to prove beyond 7f to boot.
runners.comment: 0-8 in Britain and not solid on 2026 form; still has something to prove beyond 7f
runners.owner: P And Mrs L Rowe And John Turner

runners.name: Dovey Moon
runners.spotlight: Record of 4-10 in 1m events on turf; ran respectably at Pontefract on Monday; however, remains on career-high mark and chance of landing this race may depend on the effects of first-time headgear.
runners.comment: Chance of landing this race may depend on the effects of first-time headgear

runners.name: Special Ghaiyyath
runners.spotlight: Successful for two previous yards but holds weak claims on his two efforts for current stable; chance largely depends on the effects of first-time headgear.
runners.comment: Holds weak claims on his two efforts for current stable; headgear applied

runners.name: Chilly Breeze
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced gelding who hasn't progressed from his 5f 2yo success, latterly in two races at about 7f this season for new yard; enough to prove upped further in trip.
runners.comment: Lightly raced gelding who hasn't progressed from his 5f 2yo success

races.race_name: Summer Saturday Series At Doncaster Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Jumeirah Storm
runners.spotlight: Backed into 15-2 and kept on for 2l fourth of ten on recent debut at Salisbury (6f, good); open to improvement on this second start and he's a leading contender.
runners.comment: 2l fourth of ten on recent debut at Salisbury; open to improvement; leading contender

runners.name: Mobadir
runners.spotlight: He's finished last of six on both starts (5f/6f, good/soft), but got closer to the target at Goodwood most recently when denied a clear run; in good hands to progress and he might not be far away in a first-time hood.
runners.comment: Signs of promise at Goodwood on second start and he's in good hands to progress

runners.name: Agrippa
runners.spotlight: 52,000euros foal, 55,000gns yearling; fifth foal; Naval Crown half-brother to 1m AW winner Swan Band (RPR 84); dam 1m AW 2yo winner (83), half-sister to two 7f Group-race winners; stable 7-47 (15%) with 2yos here in the last five years; the betting could be informative on debut.
runners.comment: 55,000gns yearling; half-brother to 1m AW winner (RPR 84); betting could be informative

runners.name: Beauty For Love
runners.spotlight: Beaten just over 9l when last of seven on debut in warm Newmarket novice (5f, good to firm) and took a step forward with 4l third of six at Ayr (6f, soft) a fortnight ago; bred to do better still; possible player.
runners.comment: Took a step forward when third of six at Ayr and he's bred to do better still

runners.name: War Gaming
runners.spotlight: £85,000 yearling; third foal; Mehmas half-brother to KSA 7f winner Gaasyah; dam sprint maiden (RPR 68), half-sister to winners Mister Manannan (5f/6f Listed) and Shermeen (US 8.5f stakes; dam of 6f 2yo Group 1 winner Sudirman), out of smart 6f-1m1f winner; already gelded; trainer is having a good year with his 2yos and he could be a contender on debut; wears cheekpieces.
runners.comment: £85,000 yearling; trainer is having a good year with his 2yos; could be a contender

runners.name: Blue Faith
runners.spotlight: £100,000 yearling; by Blue Point; first foal; dam unraced half-sister to Group 2 winners Penitent (1m) and Supplicant (6f 2yo), out of 6f winner; likely to improve for this debut outing but market support would bring him into the picture.
runners.comment: £100,000 yearling; likely to improve for this debut run but monitor the betting

runners.name: Launch Sequence
runners.spotlight: 58,000gns yearling, £160,000 2yo breeze-ups; second foal; Mehmas half-brother to 6f winner Unique Journey (RPR 102); dam US 8.5f turf winner, half-sister to some useful sprinters; represents powerful connections and could have a big part to play on debut.
runners.comment: £160,000 2yo breeze-ups; half-brother to 6f winner (RPR 102); could have big part to play

runners.name: Brondesbury
runners.spotlight: 58,000gns yearling; by Dark Angel; second foal; dam 5f/5.4f winner (including 2yo; runner-up in Nunthorpe), from speedy family; he may need this first run.
runners.comment: 58,000gns yearling; dam was runner-up in the Nunthorpe; he may need this first run

runners.name: Keep Kicking On
runners.spotlight: Always towards the rear on debut at Ascot (6f, good) in May then showed much brighter pace when third of six at Haydock (6f, soft), beaten about 4l; the going may not have been ideal last time and he could be an improver now back on a better surface.
runners.comment: Much brighter pace at Haydock on second start when soft going may not have been ideal

runners.name: No More Pino
runners.spotlight: Slowly away and stumbled badly mid-race when 25-1 for last month's debut at Salisbury (6f, soft), and in the circumstances he did very well to keep on for fifth of 11, beaten just over 8l; his trainer is in fine form and he could have a bright future; interesting.
runners.comment: Did very well to finish fifth on debut having stumbled badly; trainer is in fine form

runners.name: Sultan Darius
runners.spotlight: Pulled hard when fourth of 13 at 15-2 on recent debut at Windsor (6f, good to firm); this 120,000gns breeze-up buy is a brother to useful sprinting 2yo Cheerupsleepyjean and he could take a sizeable step forward if settling better; the tongue-tie is retained.
runners.comment: 4th of 13 on recent debut at Windsor; could take sizeable step forward if settling better

runners.name: Mwafaq
runners.spotlight: Progressive 4yo who made it four wins from his last six starts when scoring at Hamilton (8.3f, good to soft) last month; also effective on good/good to firm ground; a 3lb rise should not prevent another big run.
runners.comment: Progressive 4yo who has won four of his last six and can produce another big run
runners.owner: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd

runners.name: Amidst The Chaos
runners.spotlight: Runner-up at Musselburgh (1m1f, good) last month then went one better in commanding style in first-time cheekpieces at Pontefract (1m, good); could have more to offer in the headgear; strong claims under 5lb penalty.
runners.comment: Commanding win at Pontefract latest; could have more to offer in the retained cheekpieces

runners.name: Straight A
runners.spotlight: Runner-up here (7f, good to firm) in May then went very close at Redcar (1m, good); couldn't get into it after a slow start at Beverley (7.4f, good to firm) last time but still ran pretty well and he might not be far away.
runners.comment: Twice finished runner-up in May (including here) and he might not be far away

runners.name: Tilani
runners.spotlight: Won at Newbury (1m, good) in May on third start for this yard and followed up when unpenalised at Yarmouth (1m, good) five days later; runner-up off this 6lb higher mark at Goodwood (1m1f, good to soft) last time, when outstayed, and he could play a leading role back down to 1m.
runners.comment: Won two in a row at 1m and outstayed when runner-up over 1m1f; on the shortlist

runners.name: Al Muqdad
runners.spotlight: Returned from a break with good third at Ayr (7f, good to firm) in May and he went very close here (7f, good to firm) last Friday; he's done all of his winning at 7f but can be in the mix if the return to 1m isn't an issue.
runners.comment: Went very close over 7f here last Friday; in the mix if the return to 1m isn't an issue

runners.name: Valentine Catcher
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten at Redcar (7f, good) a fortnight ago, so his losing run continues, but he was in good heart previously and kept on well when making the frame at Ayr (7f, good to firm) and Carlisle (7f, good); this first crack at 1m is worth a go and he's not ruled out each-way.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten at Redcar a fortnight ago but in good heart previously; not ruled out e-w

runners.name: Toralou
runners.spotlight: Returned to form when runner-up at Ffos Las (1m, good to soft) last month on her second start back from a break; also effective on good/good to firm ground and she's one to consider.
runners.comment: Returned to form when runner-up at Ffos Las last month and she's one to consider

runners.name: Yafaarr
runners.spotlight: Sent off favourite and returned to form with a win at Redcar (1m, good) a fortnight ago; he did it a shade readily and can give another good account off this 6lb higher mark if backing up that latest performance.
runners.comment: Sent off favourite and returned to form with a ready win at Redcar a fortnight ago

runners.name: War Howl
runners.spotlight: Won over C&D (good to firm) last June and followed up at Ascot (7f, good); he's well handicapped on that form and is one to watch in the betting but he's struggled on his six starts this season.
runners.comment: One to watch in the betting but he's struggled on his six starts this season
runners.owner: Future Champions Racing Syn & Ben Haslam

runners.name: Dyonisos
runners.spotlight: 0-10 since arriving from France but twice finished runner-up in the spring (5f, good) and he was a close fifth in a tight finish at Hamilton (5f, good to firm) last week; might not be far away.
runners.comment: 0-10 since arriving from France but some good form this season and might not be far away

runners.name: Emerald Harmony
runners.spotlight: Some good efforts for her new yard this year prior to snapping a losing sequence with a win at Thirsk (5f, good) last month; that may have given her confidence a boost and she's respected back up 4lb.
runners.comment: Snapped a losing sequence at Thirsk latest and that may have given her confidence a boost

runners.name: Paddy's Day
runners.spotlight: He's just 1-25 on turf but was runner-up over C&D (good to firm) last month and wasn't beaten far in a competitive Class 2 at favourite course Newcastle (5f, AW) last Friday; could be in the mix.
runners.comment: Just 1-25 on turf but runner-up over C&D last month and could be in the mix

runners.name: Miraculous
runners.spotlight: It's possible the drop back to 5f will help but Chester brought out the best in him for Roger Varian and it's been the same story for his new yard this term; has to improve upon what he's been showing away from the Roodee.
runners.comment: Has to improve upon what he's been showing away from favourite course Chester

runners.name: Moulin Booj
runners.spotlight: Close third at Windsor (5f, good to firm) last month and another good run when runner-up at Brighton (5.2f, good to firm) latest; contender.
runners.comment: He's run well to be placed on his last two starts and he's a contender

runners.name: Oriental Prince
runners.spotlight: Won at Haydock (7f, good to firm) last May and at Newcastle (5f, AW) in November but he's a more reliable proposition on AW, on which he's 7-19 as opposed to 1-15 on turf; not at the top of his game on grass of late.
runners.comment: Won at Haydock last May but he's a more reliable proposition on AW than turf

runners.name: Mondammej
runners.spotlight: Well handicapped on the pick of last year's AW form and he may have needed his comeback run at Thirsk in May; however, this 9yo was well beaten and is without a win on turf since September 2021; others are more compelling.
runners.comment: 9yo who was well beaten on reappearance and is without a win on turf since 2021

runners.name: Redbud Sixteen
runners.spotlight: Two easy wins from the front in recent weeks, appreciating the step up to this sort of trip back on turf; due to be 4lb higher from tomorrow, after last week's Newbury demolition, and her claims are obvious for a yard bang among the winners.
runners.comment: 4lb well-in after last week's demolition; claims are obvious for in-form yard

runners.name: Footwork
runners.spotlight: Progressed during a light campaign last season and has taken it up another notch the last twice; this looks a deeper race than the Lingfield (turf) handicap in which he was narrowly beaten five weeks ago, though, and he'll need more again.
runners.comment: Taken it up another notch the last twice but this looks a deeper race than last time

runners.name: Eupator
runners.spotlight: Three fair efforts since returned to turf; two Wolverhampton wins early in the year came off lower marks in blinkers and he'll need a career-best to take this stepping back up from 1m.
runners.comment: Three fair efforts back on turf; needs a career-best to take this stepping back up from 1m
runners.owner: Middleham Park Racing I and Partner

runners.name: Bintknight
runners.spotlight: Built on her debut Ascot fifth when winning a small-field Lingfield (turf) maiden against her own sex in May; this a deal tougher now handicapping but she showed the right attitude there and remains open to further improvement.
runners.comment: Showed the right attitude last time; remains open to further improvement now handicapping

runners.name: Be Patient
runners.spotlight: Both starts over 1m on Tapeta last autumn, improving from his debut to land a novice that's worked out well enough; longer trip should suit on pedigree now handicapping and the market will give some clues after eight months off.
runners.comment: Longer trip should suit on pedigree; market will give some clues after eight months off

runners.name: Serenity Blue
runners.spotlight: Dual novice winner early last summer who's generally strugged in handicaps, including in two runs since being gelded; the drop back from 1m4f should help but this will largely come down to how he responds to first-time headgear.
runners.comment: Drop back from 1m4f ideal but this will largely come down to how he responds to headgear

runners.name: Military Air
runners.spotlight: Ex-French gelding who's struggled badly for this yard, all under Daniel Tudhope, who rides Prince Of The Seas today; handicapper easing off quickly but he's hard to recommend as he drops from 1m6f back in the hood (tongue-tie also refitted).
runners.comment: Ex-French gelding who's struggled badly for this yard; hard to recommend

runners.name: Prince Of The Seas
runners.spotlight: Goodwood winner for Ralph Beckett last August off 5lb higher; not at the same level for his current yard but he overraced last time, when cracking late over further, and looks back on a competitive mark; stable also runs Military Air.
runners.comment: Overraced last time, when cracking late over further, and looks back on a competitive mark

races.race_name: Download The Raceday Ready App Handicap

runners.name: Come On Over
runners.spotlight: Found his level now and the return of the visor, worn for his nursery near-miss last autumn off 7lb higher, had a positive effect over C&D last Friday; will be 4lb higher from tomorrow and his claims are obvious.
runners.comment: Returning visor helped over C&D last Friday; 4lb well-in and his claims are obvious
runners.owner: Come On Over Syndicate & A H Yates Ltd

runners.name: Get Up Everybody
runners.spotlight: Maiden who was disappointing as favourite when last seen five weeks ago; maybe that was down to the first-time cheekpieces (removed today) and this mark is well within range on the evidence of his other two runs since a wind operation.
runners.comment: Latest effort may have been down to cheekpieces; this mark looks within range

runners.name: Cosmic Clarets
runners.spotlight: Solid comeback before chasing home an improver at Hamilton; took a backward step as favourite over C&D (hung right) last time and is now tried in another form of headgear; went the wrong last year and has to prove he isn't following the same pattern.
runners.comment: Backward step as favourite over C&D (hung right) last time; tried in a first-time visor

runners.name: Go Victor
runners.spotlight: Ended last season with a couple of poor efforts and has picked up where he left off; soft ground was likely behind his last effort six weeks ago but he's hard to recommend even then.
runners.comment: Ended last season with a couple of poor efforts and has picked up where he left off

runners.name: Carlton And Co
runners.spotlight: Weighted to her best still, despite having run poorly in two starts back; the visor worn for last year's three wins returns today, which is an obvious plus point and could bring about an improved showing.
runners.comment: Visor worn for last year's three wins returns today, which could bring about improvement

runners.name: Kings Merchant
runners.spotlight: Progressive as a 3yo (C&D winner) but regressed last year and has continued to slide this season; hit a bit of traffic when not beaten far in first-time cheekpieces (retained) latest but others look to have stronger claims.
runners.comment: Regressed last year and has continued to slide this season; others look stronger

runners.name: Medyg
runners.spotlight: Fair in three runs on Tapeta last backend (6f-7f) before being gelded; inclined to overrace on his turf/handicap debut (6f) back from a break a couple of months ago and still has a bit of potential for a yard that got on the board for the year last weekend.
runners.comment: Still has a bit of potential for a yard that got on the board for the year last weekend

runners.name: Ishe Worth Agamble
runners.spotlight: Currently 2-4 over C&D (also finished fourth in this last year off 4lb lower); a disappointing effort last time will need forgiving but the return here will help, this time with 7lb being taken off by Jake Dickson.
runners.comment: Currently 2-4 over C&D; return here will help, this time under 7lb claimer Jake Dickson

runners.name: Maxi Boy
runners.spotlight: Regressive since returning from almost a year off and has struggled in a couple of runs back on turf (said to have been restless in the stalls last time); this is easier than he's used to, dropping back from 7f, but he has it to prove now.
runners.comment: This is easier than he's used to, dropping back from 7f, but he has it to prove now

races.race_name: Free Bets On attheraces.com Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Saffron Dandy
runners.spotlight: Landed her third win of the year three weeks ago, showing the right attitude on very soft ground (made all in a small field); this is more competitive but she's only been nudged up 1lb and that confirmed her back in form.
runners.comment: Made all on very soft ground last time; this is more competitive but back in form now

runners.name: Space Bear
runners.spotlight: String of solid runs this year, aside from when not handling the Ripon undulations in May; again inclined to pull hard when beaten on the nod last time and is given a first go over 5f off the back of it (only 1lb higher); holds claims in an open handicap.
runners.comment: Again pulled hard last time; given a first go over 5f; holds claims in an open handicap

runners.name: Dragon Spin
runners.spotlight: Career-best effort when winning at Thirsk last time; will need another forward step, upped 4lb into a stronger race, but that wouldn't come as a surprise.
runners.comment: Needs another forward step, upped 4lb into a stronger race, but that wouldn't surprise

runners.name: Alondra
runners.spotlight: Consistent filly who's been inclined to pull hard over 6f here the last twice; did well to get as close last Friday, given she fluffed the start and had to switch for a run, and has a chance of breaking her duck on turf (0-13; three-time winner on Tapeta).
runners.comment: Inclined to pull hard over 6f here the last twice; did well to get as close last Friday

runners.name: Chicory
runners.spotlight: Highly tried after winning a Newbury maiden last August; offered more on her second run back a month ago, dropped to this trip for the first time, and today's more demanding 5f should suit for a yard back among the winners in recent days.
runners.comment: Highly tried last year; today's more demanding 5f should suit; one to consider

runners.name: Alpine Girl
runners.spotlight: Won this last year off 7lb lower, when rank outsider in a small field; possible she didn't take to Ripon last time, after a career-best effort at Pontefract, but she's often done for early pace over this trip and needs to get it bang on off this mark.
runners.comment: Won this last year off 7lb lower; quiet one latest; needs to get it bang on off this mark

runners.name: Cressida Wildes
runners.spotlight: Three poor efforts since returned to turf; now back to the mark off which she won at Yarmouth (sole turf win) last July but she'll need a major revival against some in-form sprinters.
runners.comment: Three poor efforts since returned to turf; needs a revival against some in-form sprinters

runners.name: Eternal Sunshine
runners.spotlight: Progressed well once handicapping as a 4yo and kicked on again last season, landing a hat-trick in late summer, latterly here off 2lb higher; not at her best in the spring but this is her time of year and she offered more latest; respected.
runners.comment: Not at her best in the spring but this her time of year; offered more latest; respected

runners.name: Borjina
runners.spotlight: Won Catterick novice (7f, good) in April on her second start; only seventh of ten on subsequent handicap debut but she was slowly away; only 4-1 that day and retains potential; could bounce back with a big performance.
runners.comment: Won in April on second start; slowly away when seventh on h'cap debut; retains potential
runners.owner: All About York And Whatton Manor Stud

runners.name: Seeing Stars
runners.spotlight: Won Kempton maiden (7f, AW) in January on fourth start and she's run well to make the frame in her first two handicaps (7f, AW/good to firm); there's every chance that she'll be in the mix.
runners.comment: Has run well to make the frame in both handicaps and every chance she'll be in the mix

runners.name: Gunalt Wavelength
runners.spotlight: Beaten on first ten starts but got off the mark at the 11th attempt at Ripon (6f, good) in May and followed up in big field over this C&D (good); clearly progressive and a 4lb rise for last time may not stop her.
runners.comment: Made it two wins in a row when landing big-field C&D handicap latest; clearly progressive

runners.name: South Coast Star
runners.spotlight: Returned to form with a bang when easily making all at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) last month; she has an in-and-out profile and is unproven on turf, while she's 9lb higher today, but she could take plenty of catching if reproducing that latest performance.
runners.comment: Easily made all at Wolverhampton last month; could take plenty of catching with a repeat

runners.name: Bami
runners.spotlight: Ran well late last year on first four starts and showed improved form with 33-1 handicap win on reappearance at Newbury (7f, good to firm) last Tuesday; strong claims under 6lb penalty if this doesn't come too soon.
runners.comment: 33-1 win on recent reappearance at Newbury; strong claims if this doesn't come too soon

runners.name: Vega's Virtue
runners.spotlight: Won in first-time cheekpieces (retained since) at Ripon (1m, good) in May; it's a concern she pulled hard when no match for the front two at Leicester (1m, good) last time but if settling better she could be a force.
runners.comment: Won at Ripon then pulled hard when third at Leicester; could be a force if settling better

runners.name: Angel Summer
runners.spotlight: Lost her action when soundly beaten on handicap debut at Yarmouth in April; went beyond 6f for first time at Lingfield (1m, AW) last month when she failed to settle and weakened into fourth; the drop to 7f could suit.
runners.comment: Faded into 4th when upped to 1m on second handicap start; drop to 7f could be a good move

runners.name: Light The Night Up
runners.spotlight: 0-6 but has run well in fourth in 8.3f handicaps at Nottingham on her two runs this year, both on good ground in April, and she's shaped each time as though the drop back to 7f might help; possible player.
runners.comment: 4th over 8.3f at Nottingham on both starts this season and the drop back to 7f might help

runners.name: Accademia
runners.spotlight: Beaten 6l when fifth of six on seasonal/handicap debut at Lingfield (7.6f, good to firm) in May but might have needed the run; showed promise on final 2yo outing and she's bred to be better than this mark; interesting.
runners.comment: May have needed the run on handicap debut and she's bred to be better than this mark

runners.name: Sailor's Return
runners.spotlight: 0-5 in France but displayed ability and she was returning from a three-month break when sixth of ten on recent stable debut at Carlisle (7f, good); could show the benefit of that outing today; not ruled out.
runners.comment: 0-5 in France but displayed ability and could improve for her recent 6th on British debut

runners.name: Why Because
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who has more realistic claims now back in a handicap but all of her rivals are 3yos and it's likely she'll be vulnerable.
runners.comment: Lightly raced 4yo who is 0-6; all of her rivals are 3yos and likely she'll be vulnerable

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.name: Elated
runners.spotlight: Finished third in a bumper and in all her races over hurdles, from 2m to 2m3f; didn't genuinely threaten to win any of them but this is an ordinary race and cheekpieces are added.
runners.comment: Finished third in a bumper and in all her races over hurdles, from 2m to 2m3f

runners.name: Getmyfriend
runners.spotlight: Won a Southwell bumper on good ground in May but was disappointing under a penalty at Plumpton; however, she's a past winner representing the Skelton team and this isn't a strong maiden hurdle.
runners.comment: She's a bumper winner representing the Skelton team and this isn't a strong maiden hurdle

runners.name: For Her Glory
runners.spotlight: Similar profile to Getmyfriend in that she won a good-ground bumper at Southwell before coming up short under a penalty; has raced freely so the new hood may help.
runners.comment: Southwell bumper winner who was then beaten with a penalty; now hooded
runners.owner: The Cheltenham & South West Racing Club

runners.name: Likewhatyousee
runners.spotlight: Won a 1m4f heavy-ground maiden in Ireland before changing hands for 60,000gns; 16-1 when narrowly beaten over C&D three weeks ago (good) and the winner was completing a hat-trick.
runners.comment: 1m4f winner; near miss on hurdle debut here and the winner was on a hat-trick

runners.name: Princess Of Ballea
runners.spotlight: 66-1 chance when well behind Likewhatyousee here three weeks ago.
runners.comment: 66-1 chance when well behind Likewhatyousee here three weeks ago

runners.name: Steal A Glance
runners.spotlight: Low-level bumper form even when she was placed; went off 25-1 for hurdling debut here and was about 18l behind Likewhatyousee.
runners.comment: Went off 25-1 for hurdling debut here and was about 18l behind Likewhatyousee

runners.name: Winters Hill
runners.spotlight: Has finished last in all her races, two bumpers and a maiden hurdle at Worcester; now tongue tied.
runners.comment: Has finished last in all her races, two bumpers and a maiden hurdle at Worcester

runners.name: Lundy View
runners.spotlight: Just minor promise in two good-ground bumpers at this track and readily opposed.
runners.comment: Just minor promise in two good-ground bumpers at this track and readily opposed

races.race_name: Sun Racing Free Tickets With Sun Club Novices' Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Backer Bilk
runners.spotlight: Low-grade winner on the AW who has shown some aptitude for hurdling, making the frame in run-of-the-mill 2m maidens at Hereford (good) and Huntingdon (good to firm); not obviously well treated for this handicap debut but should feature in a weak race.
runners.comment: Not obviously well treated for this handicap debut but should feature in a weak race

runners.name: Adaay Dancing
runners.spotlight: 17 defeats include eight over hurdles and latest fourth in a 2m Huntingdon handicap was remote.
runners.comment: 17 defeats include eight over hurdles and latest fourth at Huntingdon was remote

runners.name: Ask Peter
runners.spotlight: Three Flat wins in 2023; 0-10 over hurdles but was only reeled in late on under James Robottom here three weeks ago (2m1f, good); clear claims off 1lb higher.
runners.comment: 0-10 over hurdles but nearly held on here three weeks ago and only 1lb higher

runners.name: Kittys Glance
runners.spotlight: Three runs after wind surgery and all the better for it; maiden winner in March and just over a length off the winner on handicap debut at Worcester 22 days ago (2m4f, good); solid.
runners.comment: Three runs after wind surgery and all the better for it; close up on handicap debut latest

runners.name: Saucats
runners.spotlight: 0-24; went close in this new headgear combination here in May but he's back on the slippery slope and out of the weights this time.
runners.comment: 0-24; he's back on the slippery slope and out of the weights this time

runners.name: Hawa Jumeirah
runners.spotlight: Dual Flat winner (1m2f/1m4f) who hasn't offered much at all over hurdles, including his handicap debut here last time when tried in a tongue-tie; went off 25-1 that day.
runners.comment: Dual Flat winner (1m2f/1m4f) who hasn't offered much at all over hurdles

races.race_name: St. Austell Brewery Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Miss Kassiopi
runners.spotlight: Won a 2m3f handicap hurdle in April for Richard Bandey whom she left for £20,000; 13-8 for recent yard debut at Hexham and went down narrowly over a trip just shy of 3m; obvious contender here off an untouched mark.
runners.comment: Went down narrowly on stable debut and an obvious contender off an untouched mark

runners.name: Hurst Hill
runners.spotlight: Only win came in this race 12 months ago off 1lb lower and she returns on the back of a 5l defeat three weeks ago; should run well, provided she takes to the new blinkers.
runners.comment: Won this last year and only beaten 5l in final run; good chance if taking to blinkers

runners.name: Ghost Jury
runners.spotlight: Third in a handicap hurdle here in May 2025; however, well beaten in two other handicaps on either side of a brief but successful stint in points; it's hard to make a compelling case but Sean Bowen has been booked.
runners.comment: Winning pointer; 0-9 over hurdles; weak form claims but Sean Bowen has been booked

runners.name: Blue Siam
runners.spotlight: Best run over hurdles when third of six finishers on her handicap debut at Stratford (2m, good to firm) in May but only fourth of the six next time; the ability is there should a first-time visor (replacing cheekpieces) do something for her.
runners.comment: Ability is there should a first-time visor (replacing cheekpieces) do something for her

runners.name: Northern Symphonie
runners.spotlight: Completed a hat-trick over hurdles last year from 2m5f (here) to 3m (all on good ground); however, she's been well below that level for current yard, over hurdles and fences.
runners.comment: Three-time winner but well below that level for current yard, over hurdles and fences

runners.name: Bee's Kiss
runners.spotlight: Pulled up on chase debut latest and very opposable back over hurdles from 7lb out of the weights; cheekpieces are tried.
runners.comment: Pulled up on chase debut latest and very opposable back over hurdles from 7lb wrong

runners.name: Global Hideaway
runners.spotlight: Bled in her final two races for Dan Skelton and was 100-1 when beaten a distance on yard debut in a 2m handicap hurdle at Southwell (good), albeit after a year off; chance hinges on this longer trip making all the difference and her pedigree offers hope.
runners.comment: Chance hinges on this longer trip making all the difference and her pedigree offers hope

runners.name: Schmilsson
runners.spotlight: Failed to beat a rival in his final two races when last seen a year ago; however, he won his first two in this discipline (2m on good ground) and would have every chance if returning in good spirits.
runners.comment: Absent for a year but this dual chase winner would have every chance if in good spirits
runners.owner: Both Sides Of The Sea Syndicate

runners.name: Duke Of Luckley
runners.spotlight: Goes particularly well at Southwell where he won again by 15l a month ago (2m, good), making all; he was granted a soft lead there and has gone up 9lb.
runners.comment: He was granted a soft lead last time at Southwell and has gone up 9lb for winning by 15l

runners.name: Krak
runners.spotlight: Recently sold out of the Twiston-Davies yard for £27,000 and has since had a wind operation; failed to fire in two previous chases but ran well in his final race over hurdles, beating all bar a talented and revitalised winner; he's of obvious interest.
runners.comment: New yard and had a wind op; probably on a good mark if he fancies a return to chasing

runners.name: Gore Point
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdle winner; proving consistent over fences and carries a penalty for Monday's 20l success at Stratford (2m3f, good to firm) where he was left clear at the last; looks sure to put up another bold show, receiving plenty of weight off his rivals.
runners.comment: Left clear at Stratford on Monday but was running a big race anyway; penalised

runners.name: Charlus
runners.spotlight: Useful Flat form in France; after winning a maiden hurdle for Willie Mullins he was essentially underwhelming under both codes and has got nothing going in three runs for Dan Skelton, including handicaps at the Cheltenham and Aintree festivals; in calmer waters here after a wind operation and disappointing should he not show a lot more.
runners.comment: Essentially regressive but has had a wind operation and he could yet stage a revival

runners.name: Continuance
runners.spotlight: Three hurdle wins at around 2m; seemed to need his run in May and then rallied to threaten an unexposed winner at Worcester (2m4f, good); that was a solid effort and he's only 1lb higher.
runners.comment: Three-time hurdle winner; rallying second at Worcester last time and only 1lb higher now

runners.name: Emerald Time
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced; it was only a Class 5 he won at Worcester (2m, good) but that was quite straightforward in the new tongue-tie and he's open to considerable improvement; raised a fair 6lb.
runners.comment: Easy winner of a Class 5 at Worcester and worth a crack at this higher level; raised 6lb

runners.name: Arctic Voyage
runners.spotlight: Once a sprinter on the Flat but has won twice over hurdles since joining current yard, a Hereford maiden and a C&D novice (both on good); hard to know what to make of his remote second in a handicap back here a month ago when the winner strolled home by some 26l.
runners.comment: Maiden/novice winner this year but hammered by the winner here in a handicap

runners.name: Max Of Stars
runners.spotlight: Beat three rivals in this 12 months ago and has added further wins since then, on the Flat and over hurdles; only beaten a length in 1m4f handicap last time after a wind operation; not handicapped out of it by any means.
runners.comment: Last year's winner who ran well on the Flat recently after a wind operation
runners.owner: Mrs S D Pearson & Ollie Pears

runners.name: Blackacre
runners.spotlight: In a new visor he won two C&D handicaps last August; hit and miss since then but the visor in which he has form figures of 115 now belatedly returns.
runners.comment: In a new visor he won two C&D handicaps last August and that aid belatedly returns

runners.name: Radharc Na Slaine
runners.spotlight: Only 1-16 over fences but it was his first run after wind surgery when coming from off the pace for a closing third at Bangor (3m, good) last week; that's something to build on and Sean Bowen is back.
runners.comment: First run after wind surgery when coming from off the pace for a closing third at Bangor

runners.name: Daring Plan
runners.spotlight: Had a few near misses before finally off the mark over 3m at Uttoxeter (good) where the front two came clear; as a last-time-out winner in this company he has to be of interest; up 4lb.
runners.comment: As a last-time-out winner in this company he has to be of interest; up 4lb
runners.owner: Miss Jane Edgar & D V Gardner

runners.name: Winning Paddy
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish pointer; benefited from the step up to this trip when winning by 8l here in early June and a slow pace back over hurdles found him out three weeks ago, though didn't run badly; 8lb higher than for both those runs but still has higher hopes than some in here.
runners.comment: C&D winner whose latest run was over hurdles; up 8lb but more appealing than some

runners.name: Mcgregors Charge
runners.spotlight: Sole success came in a 3m handicap chase on good ground at Perth last August when 6lb lower; he can cope with this mark but needs a return to form on his stable debut.
runners.comment: He can cope with this mark but needs a return to form on his stable debut

runners.name: He Is A Cracker
runners.spotlight: Good and bad in five runs for current yard, all of which were at Fontwell and Fakenham; soft ground was probably against him last time and he stays well.
runners.comment: Soft ground was probably against him last time and he stays well

runners.name: Great d'Ange
runners.spotlight: Four-time chase winner but nothing positive to report over fences or hurdles in his last four races.
runners.comment: Four chase wins but nothing positive to report over fences or hurdles in last four races

runners.name: Longhouse Star
runners.spotlight: Maiden under rules in Ireland (0-3 as a chaser) but he had a few wins and places to his name in 25 point starts; the latest wasn't his best but he still went and joined Dan Skelton for £8,000; that alone heightens interest in him.
runners.comment: Not that appealing on his Irish exploits but joining Skelton has to heighten interest

runners.name: Newbrook Diamond
runners.spotlight: Point-to-point winner (yielding) has hit the frame in five of seven starts over hurdles and rated 119; leading claims on winter maiden hurdle form but well below that level the last twice and needs to get back on track.
runners.comment: Big claims on winter maiden hurdle form, poor last twice, needs to get back on track

runners.name: Seven Towers
runners.spotlight: Placed in both point-to-points and in three of four bumpers; decent 5.5l third of 15 on hurdles debut at Tramore (2m, good); dam a 2m5f winner so could improve for this longer trip; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Placed in points and bumpers, third on hurdles debut latest, moves up in trip, shortlisted

runners.name: Captain Hanley
runners.spotlight: Modest on the Flat but has shown an aptitude for hurdling; runner up in both completed starts at Clonmel (19.5f, gd-yld) in May and Punchestown (23.5f, gd-yld) 26 days ago; in between those runs unseated early at Kilbeggan; big player.
runners.comment: Modest on the Flat, runner up both completed starts over hurdles, big player

runners.name: Tomthescaffolder
runners.spotlight: Failed to trouble the judge in both starts in bumpers; 5.5l behind Captain Hanley when fourth of 17 on hurdles debut at Clonmel (19.5f, gd-yld) in May; sharper for that and could get closer to that rival now; preferred by Darragh O'Keeffe.
runners.comment: 5.5l behind Captain Hanley on hurdles debut, sharper for that, could go closer now

runners.name: Magical Sal
runners.spotlight: Best run in bumpers a 7.75l fifth of 9 at Downpatrick in May (2m2f, good); didn't back that up when beaten 36l back there on latest; best watched on hurdling debut.
runners.comment: Promise in Downpatrick bumper on penultimate, poor back there latest, watch

runners.name: Majestic Horizon
runners.spotlight: Point-to-point winner sent off short enough prices for both bumpers and not beaten that far when third here (2m1f, gd-yld) and Downpatrick (2m2f, gd-yld); bred to make a hurdler and could go well up in trip.
runners.comment: Point winner, promise in both bumpers, up in trip for hurdles' debut, could go well

runners.name: Colwyn Bay
runners.spotlight: Promise when third in a Clonmel bumper in April but no impact twice since, including when falling on hurdles debut at Downpatrick on latest at 150-1.
runners.comment: Promise on debut in Clonmel bumper, 150-1 and fell on hurdles debut at Downpatrick

runners.name: Fou De Toi
runners.spotlight: Placed on sole French start; modest form in first two Irish maiden hurdles on soft and heavy ground before pulling up on handicap debut at Fairyhouse (3m, yld-sft) 90 days ago; brother to a good-ground winner, so could improve for this sounder surface; can't discount.
runners.comment: Poor Irish form so far on soft ground, could improve for sounder surface, can't discount

runners.name: Midnight Musical
runners.spotlight: Fine effort when a close second on Rules' debut in a Galway bumper last August and highly tried on two of next three starts to no avail; well beaten favourite on hurdles debut at Kilbeggan 49 days ago; needs more.
runners.comment: Promise in Galway bumper, well beaten fav' on hurdles debut latest, needs more

runners.name: Sea Feliz
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; Getaway mare; E19,000 3yo; half-sister to 2m-2m4f hurdle winner Morricone; dam bumper winner, half-sister to useful bumper and 2m-2m5f hurdle/chase winner Encore Champs; top yard and worth a market check if gets a run.
runners.comment: E19,000 Getaway mare, dam bumper winner, check market if gets a run; reserve

runners.name: Chasing Blues
runners.spotlight: Disappointed when favourite in a Navan bumper on debut and had come under pressure when slipping up in a Killarney maiden hurdle when last seen in May 2025 when trained by Gavin Cromwell; new yard now and likely capable of better but O'Keeffe prefers stablemate.
runners.comment: Not much encouragement in two starts last year, new yard, O'Keefe prefers stablemate

runners.name: Rosie Brown
runners.spotlight: First reserve; heavy defeats in three bumpers and when 150-1 on hurdles debut at Punchestown; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Heavy defeats in three bumpers and on hurdles debut latest, hard to fancy; reserve

runners.name: Ellis Brittle
runners.spotlight: Order Of St George gelding; dam well beaten in bumpers, half-sister to winners Smitty Bacall (bumper and 2m4f-3m2f hurdle/chase), Palm Sur (bumper) and Sullivan's Brow (2m hurdle); likely best watched on debut.
runners.comment: Order Of St George gelding, dam well beaten in bumpers, best watched on debut

runners.name: Great Entirely
runners.spotlight: Left previous modest efforts behind when an 11.5l fifth of 12 in a Kilbeggan maiden hurdle (2m, gd-yld) 18 days ago; a good bit more needed to take this.
runners.comment: Improved effort in Kilbeggan maiden hurdle latest, more needed to take this

runners.name: Mind Eraser
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; just mild promise in point-to-points in April/May; major improvement needed if he's to make an impact on Rules' debut.
runners.comment: Mild promise in points, more needed to make an impact on Rules' debut; reserve

runners.name: Lastofthenatives
runners.spotlight: Valirann gelding soundly beaten in first two point-to-points before pulling up on latest at Dromahane in April; hard to fancy and best watched on Rules' debut.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten first two points, pulled up latest, watch on Rules' debut

runners.name: Nile Star
runners.spotlight: Triple-figure odds and soundly beaten in three 2m maiden hurdles on heavy ground in January/February; better ground now but can only be watched.
runners.comment: Triple figure odds and no show in trio of m'den hurdles on heavy, best watched

runners.name: Oh So Charming
runners.spotlight: Sole hurdles win came over a year ago at Clonmel (2m4f) off 111; tried several times in claiming hurdles this year, notably C&D second in May, reportedly found to have blood in nostrils last month when just fair fifth in Downpatrick handicap; has to be treated with some caution but down to a nice mark.
runners.comment: C&D claiming second on penultimate; blood in nostrils on latest though

runners.name: You Done Well
runners.spotlight: Sole hurdles win came in 2m3f Limerick handicap last May on good; claimed out of Declan Queally's yard at Clonmel in May (4,000euros) and solid start for new connections when staying-on third in 2m4f Clonmel handicap last month; one to consider.
runners.comment: Yard debut third at Clonmel last month gives him claims

runners.name: Kentucky Bluebird
runners.spotlight: Mare is now 0-8 hurdling, one of better efforts on latest when front-running fourth of 14 over C&D; more needed but possible.
runners.comment: Recent front-running fourth of 14 over C&D encouraging; more needed but possible

runners.name: Tropical Twist
runners.spotlight: Hasn't completed in two handicap attempts, last-flight faller (beaten) at Navan and pulled up after not handling track at Bellewstown; possibly best watched for now.
runners.comment: Hasn't completed in two handicap attempts, possibly best watched for now

runners.name: Esticky End
runners.spotlight: Flat winner is now 0-14 over hurdles, well held over C&D on penultimate, badly hampered at Tramore since.
runners.comment: Well held of late off this basement mark

runners.name: Glendine Billy
runners.spotlight: Placed twice back in 2024; comeback run in April wasn't devoid of promise but lot more needed.
runners.comment: Comeback run in April wasn't devoid of promise but lot more needed

runners.name: Mount Ferns
runners.spotlight: Hurdles win in 2024 came at Listowel (2m, soft) off 91; returned there last September for a staying-on third in the same event; pulled up at Cork in May on reappearance after a winter break; watching brief on this quicker ground.
runners.comment: Best form on softer ground, watching brief advised
runners.owner: K McNamee & Manorplace Ltd & V Casey & F G Doran

runners.name: Grey Gardens
runners.spotlight: Returned for promising handicap debut at Down Royal in early May, none too fluent and short of room at crucial time when third of 20 over today's trip (good); later in month disappointing favourite over C&D, jumping letting him down; remains a potential improver given more fluent round of jumping.
runners.comment: Jumping let him down over C&D last time; remains potential improver given better jumping

runners.name: Lakota Blue
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner is 0-9 over hurdles, best form on soft; promising Kilbeggan chasing debut in May and fair third in Downpatrick handicap on final start for Gordon Elliott; headgear left off here on yard debut back hurdling.
runners.comment: Maiden showed some promise chasing for Gordon Elliott but has since left yard

runners.name: Cinnabar Moth
runners.spotlight: Didn't land a blow on last month's handicap debut at Listowel but some promise; potential improver.
runners.comment: Didn't land a blow on last month's handicap debut but some promise; potential improver

runners.name: Dark Berkshire
runners.spotlight: Very ordinary form in maidens and no sign of progress so far in handicaps; first-time cheekpieces need to bring serious improvement.
runners.comment: Nothing so far in handicaps, cheekpieces need to bring serious improvement

runners.name: Mount Hotham
runners.spotlight: Latest Kilbeggan run only mildly encouraging, lots more needed.
runners.comment: Latest Kilbeggan run only mildly encouraging, lots more needed

runners.name: He Who Dares
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten in both recent handicaps at big odds; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten in both recent handicaps at big odds; hard to fancy

runners.name: Barrogstown Girl
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; progressive Flat handicapper in 2024, winning three times on good/yielding; three maiden hurdle runs haven't revealed much but potential improver entering handicaps and worth a market check if getting a run.
runners.comment: Flat winner worth a market check on handicp hurdle debut if getting a run; reserve

runners.name: Mr Macphisto
runners.spotlight: Both wins have been on decent ground (2m); absent since halfway faller at Navan in November 2024 so likely to need this comeback run.
runners.comment: Absent since halfway faller at Navan in November 2024 so likely to need this comeback run

runners.name: O'Grady Cracker
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; lightly raced 4yo soundly beaten in four starts, including Clonmel handicap in April on latest.
runners.comment: 4yo soundly beaten in four starts, including Clonmel handicap in April on latest; reserve

runners.name: Syosset
runners.spotlight: First reserve; ended poor run of form with shock Dundalk AW win in November, okay comeback run there in March; 0-5 hurdling, last time when tailed off in Downpatrick handicap in September, but yard going well.
runners.comment: AW win encouraging, remains unexposed hurdling; reserve

runners.name: Le Diablo
runners.spotlight: Won 2m1f Clonmel handicap in April (yielding), couple of ordinary runs since off revised mark, albeit hampered at same venue on latest; bit to prove now.
runners.comment: Clonmel winner hampered at same venue latest

runners.name: Doyen Og
runners.spotlight: Placed over this trip at Bellewstown last summer (good) off 80, badly hampered when pulled up on comeback run at Listowel in late May so that run forgiven; blinkers now tried.
runners.comment: Excuses on latest; blinkers now tried and trip/ground to suit

runners.name: Hatfield Hammer
runners.spotlight: Off the mark over C&D in May last year (good) and second in similar event subsequently off 99; recent Clonmel comeback run should have brought him on and one for the shortlist.
runners.comment: C&D winner for whom recent Clonmel comeback run should have brought him on; shortlisted

runners.name: Bossing It
runners.spotlight: Maiden winner whose standout effort in handicaps when C&D second in May; didn't land a blow in better-class Listowel contest on latest but respected back in grade here.
runners.comment: Penultimate C&D second puts her in the mix dropped back in grade

runners.name: Backinabit
runners.spotlight: Best handicap run when fourth at Roscommon last year but well below that level twice after and dropped out quickly on seasonal return last month at Sligo; blinkers tried.
runners.comment: Dropped out quickly on seasonal return last month at Sligo; blinkers tried

runners.name: Hidalgo Des Mottes
runners.spotlight: Long-standing maiden over hurdles but numerous placings, including good second in 2m3f Punchestown lady riders' contest last month; has his chance again, encouraging jockey booking.
runners.comment: Recent Punchestown second has his chance again, encouraging jockey booking

runners.name: Bella Union
runners.spotlight: Veteran finally made the breakthrough in 2m1f Bellewstown handicap in April and duly followed up at Down Royal off 5lb higher; solid C&D run since off further 8lb higher mark when chasing home a clear-cut winner; contender again.
runners.comment: Veteran has hit form of late, C&D second on latest; contender again

runners.name: Baby Fish
runners.spotlight: Lightly-raced 5yo mare was never sighted on handicap debut at Downpatrick; tongue-tie now tried.
runners.comment: Lightly raced 5yo mare never sighted on handicap debut at Downpatrick; tongue-tie tried

runners.name: Sneddy Eddie
runners.spotlight: Three minor wins on the Flat; has struggled in maiden hurdles, but possible improver now switched to Gordon Elliott on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Nothing in maidens but potential improver now switched to Gordon Elliott on handicap debut

runners.name: Kilt
runners.spotlight: Useful Flat form and not much to show over hurdles until much improved for C&D win in late May under more positive ride, clear some way out; 9lb rise for that so could well have more to offer.
runners.comment: C&D winner in May upped 9lb but could well have more to offer

runners.name: Brave Josee
runners.spotlight: Attracted attention of Stewards over C&D in May before much-improved showing when favourite at Sligo last month, every chance when second over 2m5f (good); back in trip here and has to be on the shortlist.
runners.comment: Sligo second an improving type; back in trip here and has to be on the shortlist

runners.name: My Mate Tony
runners.spotlight: Maiden has struggled off stiff mark in opening handicaps; down 4lb but remains of limited appeal unless first-time tongue-tie brings serious improvement.
runners.comment: Struggled so far in handicaps, remains harshly treated; tongue-tie tried

runners.name: Mountain Port
runners.spotlight: Tramore maiden winner in 2024 has largely struggled in handicaps; absent since modest fourth in Tramore Flat maiden last August so likely best watched.
runners.comment: Absent since modest fourth in Tramore Flat maiden last August so likely best watched

runners.name: Out Moll's Gap
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; couple of poor opening efforts in handicaps, hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Couple of poor opening efforts in handicaps, hard to fancy; reserve

runners.name: Bob The Builder
runners.spotlight: First reserve; standout run over hurdles when third in 2m4f maiden here back in 2023, well held in C&D handicap when last seen in August; recent point-to-point runs should have him straight.
runners.comment: Well held in C&D handicap when last seen in August; point-to-point runs of late; reserve

runners.name: Davitts Quay
runners.spotlight: Unexposed 5yo entering handicaps on the back of three poor runs in maidens; hard to fancy off this mark but worth a market check.
runners.comment: Three poor runs in maidens; hard to fancy off this mark but worth a market check

runners.name: Notmiwadi
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; nothing obvious in three maiden runs last year to suggest she'll have an immediate impact in handicaps.
runners.comment: Nothing in maidens to suggest she'll have an immediate impact in handicaps; reserve

runners.name: Doctor Elvis
runners.spotlight: Strong winter maiden hurdle form; disappointed on handicap debut at Fairyhouse in April but runner up returned to maiden company at Cork (24.5f, good) on latest; blinkers replace cheekpieces; rated 117 and sets the standard.
runners.comment: Strong winter maiden hurdle form, good run at Cork latest, sets the standard; blinkers

runners.name: Young Doran
runners.spotlight: Sent off at 33-1 on debut in a Ballinrobe maiden hurdle (22.5f, good) 39 days ago but belied those odds to run a fine race in second, beaten 6l by a progressive rival; shaped like further would suit that days, so he's a big player upped in trip.
runners.comment: Very promising introduction at Ballinrobe, big player now stepped up in trip

runners.name: Glenary Prince
runners.spotlight: Tailed off on debut at Fairyhouse (2m4f, yld-sft); sent off at just 3-1 upped in trip on better ground at Punchestown (23.5f, gd-yld), but weakened late and beaten 18l into fourth; overlooked by O'Keeffe; needs more.
runners.comment: Tailed off on debut, beaten 18l upped to 23.5f at Punchestown when 3-1, needs more

runners.name: Benner Wenner
runners.spotlight: 12-1 and never landed a blow on debut in a Ballinrobe maiden hurdle (22.5f, good) 39 days ago; in good hands but may need more time.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten on debut at Ballinrobe, in good hands but may need more time

runners.name: Spill A Drop
runners.spotlight: Point-to-point winner (dead-heated) but that form has not worked out; not as good twice since and headgear applied for rules' debut; best watched.
runners.comment: Form of point win hasn't worked out, headgear on for Rules' debut, watch

runners.name: Bridgie Browne
runners.spotlight: Long odds and no impact in bumpers at Clonmel and at this venue; best watched stepped up markedly in trip for hurdling debut.
runners.comment: No show in bumpers at Clonmel and here, upped in trip for hurdles debut, watch

runners.name: Im A Dream Twister
runners.spotlight: Getaway mare is bred to have a future over hurdles, but she was pulled up in both point-to-points; can only watch for now.
runners.comment: Getaway mare, bred to have a future but pulled up in both points, can only watch

runners.name: Pacy Macie
runners.spotlight: Best effort in three point-to-points a 13l second at Tullaherin and the winner of that race has since placed in a bumper; pulled up at Toomebridge on latest, though, and is likely best watched on rules' debut.
runners.comment: Runner up in one of three points, pulled up at Toomerbridge latest, likely best watched

runners.name: Phoenix Lights
runners.spotlight: Always near the back before pulled up on debut at Punchestown when 66-1; cheekpieces go on.
runners.comment: 66-1 and pulled up on debut at Punchestown, cheekpieces go on now

runners.name: Talas Kera
runners.spotlight: No signs yet of winning potential in five bumpers and three runs over hurdles; beaten 63l in mares' hurdle at Kilbeggan latest; rated just 79 and hard to make a case for on form.
runners.comment: No show in bumpers or three starts over timber, rated 79, hard to make a case for on form

runners.name: The Boysofairhill
runners.spotlight: Point-to-point winner at the fifth attempt at Dromahane in April; soundly beaten at long odds in two bumpers and a Sligo maiden hurdle on latest; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Point winner, soundly beaten in two bumpers and maiden hurdle latest, hard to fancy

runners.name: Mayo Shirocco
runners.spotlight: Point-to-point winner in October 2024; no impact in a trio of maiden hurdles at 2m-3m in the spring of 2025; modest efforts back in point-to-points when last seen in October/November; others make more appeal.
runners.comment: Point winner, struggled in three previous maiden hurdles, lacks a recent run

runners.name: Vangaway
runners.spotlight: Triple-figure odds for all three starts in maiden hurdles and ran accordingly; moves up in trip; seems safe to rule out.
runners.comment: Huge odds for all three starts and ran accordingly, seems safe to rule out

runners.name: Mambo Du Large
runners.spotlight: Pulled up in sole point-to-point (gd-yld) and beaten 42l when 125-1 on hurdles debut at Clonmel (16.5f, good) last month; steps up in trip; unlikely; unplaced at Limerick last night
runners.comment: Pulled up in sole point, beaten 42l on hurdles bow last month, moves up in trip, unlikely

runners.name: Coyote Spirit
runners.spotlight: Bumper and maiden hurdle win came on very testing ground at Navan in February (2m); didn't count on last month's chase debut at Kilbeggan, but entitled to come on for the experience.
runners.comment: 123-rated hurdler; entitled to come on from recent chase debut

runners.name: Cinammon Roll
runners.spotlight: Point-to-point winner and 126-rated hurdler, winning 2m6f Downpatrick maiden and 2m4f Perth novice last year; below form when last seen in October, but respected on chase bow.
runners.comment: 126-rated hurdler absent since October but respected on chase debut

runners.name: Jackson Lamb
runners.spotlight: 118-rated hurdler won Bellewstown maiden and Kelso novice late last summer on good ground; none too fluent and pulled up on chasing debut at Kilbeggan in late May, so needs to jump much better; yard going well and has his ground.
runners.comment: Needs to jump much better than at Kilbeggan; yard going well and has his ground

runners.name: Donnie Devito
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdles winner last year at about 2m4f; good bit of chasing experience, notably third in 2m6f Galway beginners' last summer and second in 3m Clonmel novice; fourth in this race last year.
runners.comment: Fourth in this race last year; experience an advantage but more needed

runners.name: Duke Silver
runners.spotlight: Very useful staying hurdler, winning 2m4f handicap here and 3m contests at Listowel and Leopardstown last term; career-best when last seen finishing third of 24 in 3m Listed handicap at Punchestown festival in April; closely related to yard's good chaser San Salvador, so good chance he'll take to chasing; trip on the short side, but has won around here before so greatly respected.
runners.comment: Very useful staying hurdler; trip on the short side for chase debut but greatly respected
