runners.name: Pinot Gris
runners.spotlight: Smart hurdler (rated 143) at his best, albeit soundly beaten in competitive handicaps final two starts last term; bit laboured in his jumping on chasing debut at Clonmel in April (soft), but has had time off since and no surprise if he returned with an improved display; has to be considered on favoured ground.
runners.comment: Highest-rated of these hurdling; needs to jump better, ground to suit; big player

runners.name: Fillyoureye
runners.spotlight: 123-rated hurdler whose best form is on softer ground; unseated on last month's chase debut at Punchestown when leading; can't be ruled out if putting in a clear round.
runners.comment: Unseated on recent chase debut but can't be ruled out if putting in a clear round
runners.owner: Mrs N Flynn & John Joseph Flynn

runners.name: Silent Selector
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdles winner on good ground rated 99; ground to suit, but lots to find with several of these now switched to fences.
runners.comment: 99-rated hurdler; ground to suit but lots to find with several of these switched to fences

runners.name: Wing Back
runners.spotlight: Downpatrick handicap hurdle winner last summer is rated 95 in that discipline; absent since October and this looks a stiff task on chasing debut.
runners.comment: 95-rated hurdler absent since October and this looks a stiff task on chasing debut

runners.name: Eclipse Chaser
runners.spotlight: 121-rated hurdler made a promising enough start to chasing when third in 2m7f beginners' here in May, not quite getting home under positive ride; shorter trip here could suit, but more needed.
runners.comment: Promising enough chase debut here in May; shorter trip could suit but more needed

runners.name: Mickie Angel
runners.spotlight: Winning hurdler over 2m4f on heavy for Gavin Cromwell last season; pick of five attempts chasing when outstayed late on by a well-handicapped rival in 2m7f Limerick handicap at Christmas (soft-to-heavy); not so good following month at Navan and given a break since; ground likely on the quick side.
runners.comment: Best form on heavy; back from a break and quick ground a concern

runners.name: Lisleigh Lad
runners.spotlight: Dual hunter chase winner did fine in handicaps last term, placed on three occasions including when going close at Leopardstown (2m5f) in March; although flattered, it was a nice run in a Listowel conditions event last time and can go well off a light weight with good ground no issue.
runners.comment: Dual hunter chase winner did fine in handicaps last term, placed on three occasions

runners.name: Antrim Coast
runners.spotlight: Beat smart Oscars Brother in 3m hurdle here when with Gavin Cromwell; maiden over fences but his second of 20 in the Galway Blazers (2m6f) at last summer's festival showed what he's capable of; back from a long break and this smacks of a Galway prep, with yard also having likely favourite in this.
runners.comment: Fine second of 20 in the Galway Blazers (2m6f) last summer; this smacks of a Galway prep

runners.name: Nouvotic
runners.spotlight: Has won three of his last four chases, two of them coming over C&D, and was impressive when making all in Grade 3 handicap at the Punchestown festival last time; ground to suit again and little to dislike, apart from rising mark.
runners.comment: Has won three of his last four chases, two of them coming over C&D, impressive last time

runners.name: Rexem
runners.spotlight: Three wins over hurdles, 1-14 over fences; second twice over fences on decent ground at Musselburgh in January, over 2m7f on the latter occasion, and his hurdles run at Kilbeggan last time wasn't bad; most of his better runs have been right-handed, though.
runners.comment: Hurdling run at Kilbeggan not bad; most of better runs have been right-handed, though

runners.name: Ma Jacks Hill
runners.spotlight: Point and bumper winner; off the mark on second chase start in useful five-runner novice over 2m4f at Punchestown; hung right at Limerick the time before, and going left-handed may not be ideal.
runners.comment: Won useful 2m4f five-runner novice at Punchestown; going left-handed may not be ideal.

runners.name: Itsalladream
runners.spotlight: Highly tried and has cut little ice, including thrice at Grade 3 level, since winning a 2m novice at Roscommon last summer; appeared to run well behind much higher-rated rivals in conditions contest at Listowel last time, but marksman left him alone; capable of being competitive in first handicap.
runners.comment: Appeared to run well behind higher-rated rivals at Listowel, but marksman left him alone

runners.name: Bridie's Beau
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdles winner on winter ground and had two good handicap chase runs in December, winning at Clonmel and pipped off 2lb lower mark at Navan; out of form since and good ground is a concern.
runners.comment: Two good handicap chase runs in December, out of form since and good ground a concern

runners.name: Clonshire River
runners.spotlight: Jumps and travels well but is a weak finisher with a good few seconds to his name; positive is that his sole chase win came after four months off and ground will suit, but seems best right-handed.
runners.comment: Jumps and travels well but is a weak finisher with a good few seconds to his name

runners.name: Watch The Weather
runners.spotlight: Good record at this venue, including C&D win in 2024; 10-1 for Mayo National at Ballinrobe in late May after an encouraging run over hurdles, but was tailed off; chase mark is dropping and capable of going well back here.
runners.comment: Good record at this venue, including C&D win in 2024; capable of going well back here

runners.name: Kings Jet
runners.spotlight: Comes from the point-to-point/hunter chase scene and won 2m7f hunters' on good ground last year; 80-1 when pulled up in the Cheltenham festival hunter chase in March; hard to weigh up and only a 6yo, but prefer to watch.
runners.comment: Won 2m7f hunters on good ground last year; 80s when pulled up at Cheltenham; hard to gauge

runners.name: Vina Ardanza
runners.spotlight: Useful hurdler/chaser for Gordon Elliott a few years ago; modest enough form in points and hunter chases since joining this yard in late 2024.
runners.comment: Useful hurdler/chaser for Gordon Elliott; modest in points/hunter chases more recently

runners.name: Harry Des Ongrais
runners.spotlight: Ex-Henry de Bromhead; third in Listed handicap at Navan in December, but lost form after and best runs have been on soft terrain; sold for 28,000gns in March and makes stable debut here.
runners.comment: Ex-Henry de Bromhead; third in Listed handicap at Navan in December, but lost form after

races.race_name: Save The Date 7th August Ladies Day Handicap Chase

runners.name: My Good Pal
runners.spotlight: Sole hurdles win came here, under regular rider, last summer, and placed three times over flights later in 2025; only had three completed starts over fences, best of them his Downpatrick second to subsequent easy winner Dinoland over nearly 3m; early exit last time; this trip seems closer to his optimum.
runners.comment: Course hurdles winner was second to well-treated rival in Downpatrick chase

runners.name: Giant Haystacks
runners.spotlight: Won big-field Leopardstown 2m4f handicap hurdle at Christmas meeting in 2024; fourth to stablemate Driveonwill in a beginners' at Downpatrick; 3l off runner-up A Snow White Park in another beginners' last time and nice pull at the weights with her; second handicap run and mark looks exploitable.
runners.comment: Won 2m4f Leopardstown handicap hurdle; second h'cap chase run and mark looks exploitable

runners.name: Tingarran Express
runners.spotlight: Three hurdle wins have all been right-handed, but has been placed here; good run behind an improver last time; chase debut and said to jump well at home.
runners.comment: Three hurdle wins have all been right-handed, but has been placed here; chase debut

runners.name: Sampoet
runners.spotlight: Point winner and placed in pair of hunter chases last year; around 8l off the old boy Fr Gilligansvoyge over nearly 3m at Downpatrick, his best effort in handicaps so far; change of headgear.
runners.comment: Around 8l off Fr Gilligansvoyge over nearly 3m at Downpatrick, best handicap run so far

runners.name: Luimneach
runners.spotlight: First reserve; dual hurdles winner; not as good at this game but was second at Down Royal in January and, after a break, ran okay on stable debut at Kilbeggan, both of those efforts coming over a furlong farther.
runners.comment: Dual hurdles winner; not as good at this game but ran okay on stable debut; reserve

runners.name: Ingenious Stroke
runners.spotlight: Won a Downpatrick beginners' chase last time out, beating the useful Final Orders, but that was in September 2022; formerly with Henry de Bromhead, and present trainer does a lot of the jumping work with his horses.
runners.comment: Beat the useful Final Orders last time out at Downpatrick, but that was in September 2022

runners.name: Fr Gilligansvoyge
runners.spotlight: Veteran with poor strike rate, but has found a bit of form lately culminating in a win over nearly 3m at Downpatrick; a quick look at his lengthy race record reveals that he hardly ever runs left-handed, though, which has to be a for a reason.
runners.comment: Old boy won over farther at Downpatrick, but hardly ever runs left-handed

runners.name: A Snow White Park
runners.spotlight: Didn't go on over hurdles after big-priced debut win; has run well in both chase starts at Tramore, not beaten far in 2m handicap, and 2m6f may have stretched her in a beginners' last time; not sure about racing left-handed, but she does jump left.
runners.comment: Ran well both chase starts at Tramore; not sure about going left-handed, but jumps left

runners.name: King's Son
runners.spotlight: Second in sole point and in a maiden hurdle here; good start over regulation fences when staying-on third in Downpatrick handicap over this trip.
runners.comment: Good start over regulation fences when staying-on third over this trip at Downpatrick

runners.name: L'Amiral Fromentin
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; youngster has been placed in three of his last five starts over shorter, including good second over 2m here on Tuesday; query about stamina over this trip.
runners.comment: Placed in three of last five runs, including good second over 2m here on Tuesday; reserve

runners.name: Ixigreczed
runners.spotlight: Unplaced in 14 starts, four of them over fences, since winning 2m3f Kilbeggan handicap hurdle two years ago; glimmer of promise over hurdles three runs back, poor since.
runners.comment: Unplaced in 14 starts, four of them over fences, since winning Kilbeggan hurdle in 2024

runners.name: Temptationinmilan
runners.spotlight: Won a pair of chases for Charles Byrnes, latest of them over three years ago; not shown much in hunter chases for this yard, and weakened when tried in blinkers in a handicap last time.
runners.comment: Not shown much in hunter chases for this yard, and weakened in blinkers last time

runners.name: Driveonwill
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; 10-race maiden over hurdles; off the mark over fences in Downpatrick beginners' over this trip; favourite for handicap over same C&D, was in second position when departing two out.
runners.comment: Off the mark in Downpatrick beginners'; in touch when exiting two out in h'cap; reserve

runners.name: Le Malin
runners.spotlight: Useful hurdler in France as a youngster and had one very good run in a hunter-chase; last seen at Christmas in 2024 when winning 2m4f handicap at Down Royal after a couple of pleasing runs before that; runs off same mark, due to his absence, and goes well fresh.
runners.comment: Last seen at Christmas in 2024 when winning 2m4f handicap at Down Royal; goes well fresh

runners.name: Sledgehammer
runners.spotlight: Won a point on yielding ground in March; well held in hunter chases since; not crying out to be suported on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Won a point on yielding ground in March; well held in hunter chases since

runners.name: Party Pack
runners.spotlight: 16-race maiden over hurdles, albeit his sole placed effort came here over 2m1f last summer; didn't jump well when pulled up on only chase start.
runners.comment: Sole placed effort over hurdles came here; mistakes when pulled up on only chase start

runners.name: Sunwalk
runners.spotlight: Flat winner was regressive over hurdles before finishing second, from out of the blue, at Down Royal over Christmas; hasn't backed that up and now tries chasing; second-string for local yard.
runners.comment: Hurdling second, from out of the blue, at Down Royal over Christmas; now tries chasing

runners.name: Hey Sir
runners.spotlight: Modest maiden pointer and unable to be competitive in three hunter chases; hard to make a case for him; tongue-tie.
runners.comment: Modest maiden pointer and unable to be competitive in three hunter chases;  tongue-tie

runners.name: Deadheat
runners.spotlight: Second veteran runner for northern yard; winner over 3m1f here but that was in 2020; lightly raced and poor form in recent years; they say Darragh O'Keeffe is game enough to ride anything, and here's the proof.
runners.comment: Winner over 3m1f here but that was in 2020; lightly raced and poor form in recent years

races.race_name: Racing Again 22nd July INH Flat Race

runners.name: Minnatrix
runners.spotlight: Mishaps twice since promising debut in Roscommon bumper in September, achieving highest RPR of any of these when second to a decent sort who went on to win twice over hurdles in Britain.
runners.comment: Mishaps twice since promising debut in Roscommon bumper in September, highest RPR of these

runners.name: Cotswold Blue
runners.spotlight: Authorized half-sister to four winners is out of a half-sister to Big Buck's; beaten fair and square when favourite for Tramore debut but the winner had solid form; hood stays on.
runners.comment: Beaten fair and square when favourite at Tramore debut but the winner had solid form

runners.name: Perfect Order
runners.spotlight: By Lulamba's sire, Nirvana Du Berlais; dam won over fences in France, half-sister to smart 2m-2m2f hurdle winner Rolling Star.
runners.comment: By Lulamba's sire, Nirvana Du Berlais; dam chase winner in France
runners.owner: Call It What You Like Syndicate

runners.name: Mistakenforanother
runners.spotlight: Flat-bred daughter of Free Eagle; improved from Clonmel debut when second of 14 at Kilbeggan, just half-a-length in front of the staying-on Tale Of Intrigue.
runners.comment: Improved from debut when second at Kilbeggan, half-a-length in front of Tale Of Intrigue

runners.name: Highlander Addict
runners.spotlight: Placed in two of his four starts; Evens fav at Tramore, keen early and onpaced late when beaten 2.5l on good ground; this looks a stronger contest.
runners.comment: Placed twice; Evens fav at Tramore, keen early and onpaced late when beaten 2.5l

runners.name: Martymill
runners.spotlight: Not far off a subsequent Grade 2 winner when fourth on debut at Fairyhouse in November; back to form over 2m4f at Listowel when fitted with cheekpieces, second to a previous winner.
runners.comment: Promising fourth on debut at Fairyhouse and back to form over 2m4f at Listowel last month

runners.name: Ballybollen
runners.spotlight: First reserve; Nathaniel half-brother to four winners, notably Stuart Crawford's useful bumper performer  Mongibello, out of French 1m1f/10.5f winner.
runners.comment: Nathaniel half-brother to four winners, notably useful bumper mare Mongibello; reserve

runners.name: Orderly Conduct
runners.spotlight: Order Of St George gelding; unraced dam is related to several useful bumper and hurdle performers, out of smart bumper/2m-3m hurdle winner Refinement; bred to go well in this type of contest.
runners.comment: Order Of St George gelding; dam is related to several useful bumper/hurdle performers

runners.name: False Dawn
runners.spotlight: Ballylinch-bred Make Believe filly is from family of US 1m Grade 1 winner Jack Milton; totally unfancied for Punchestown winners' contest last month, but ran very well despite being too free and pulling herself into the lead, beaten less than 4l.
runners.comment: Totally unfancied for Punchestown winners' race, but ran very well beaten less than 4l

runners.name: Boston Common
runners.spotlight: Elusive Pimpernel 6yo; dam 1m2f/1m5f Flat and 2m hurdle winner; remote second in a point last year; rules debut.
runners.comment: Elusive Pimpernel 6yo; dam 1m2f/1m5f Flat and 2m hurdle winner; remote second in a point

runners.name: Go Away
runners.spotlight: Getaway 5yo bred by Honeysuckle's owner; dam French 1m7f hurdle winner, sister to French 1m2f winner, and half-sister to smart bumper and hurdle/chase winner Leave Of Absence.
runners.comment: Getaway 5yo bred by Honeysuckle's owner; dam French 1m7f hurdle winner

runners.name: Optical Illusion
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; daughter of Getaway from family of classy jumper Identity Thief; no show in two points.
runners.comment: Daughter of Getaway, family of classy jumper Identity Thief; poor in two points; reserve

runners.name: Poet's Sonnet
runners.spotlight: Poet's Word half-brother to point winner; dam hunter chase/prolific point winner, out of unraced half-sister to prolific 7f-1m4f winner Rashay; 6-4 fav when disappointing in a point, but respected connections and top rider.
runners.comment: 6-4 fav when disappointing in a point, but respected connections and top rider

runners.name: Tale Of Intrigue
runners.spotlight: Nice Newtown Anner Flat pedigree but Fascinating Rock gelding cost buttons at two; nothing in first two starts but really getting the message late on when coming home well for third at Kilbeggan, just behind Mistakenforanother.
runners.comment: Nothing in first two starts, but came home well for third at Kilbeggan last month

runners.name: S T Hamo
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; big prices and well held in first two bumpers; tongue-tie fitted.
runners.comment: Big prices and well held in first two bumpers; tongue-tie fitted. reserve

runners.name: Speisialta
runners.spotlight: Wore a hood and tongue-tie when 15-2 for Punchestown debut in January, keen and went off into a clear lead before weakening to be beaten 24l.
runners.comment: 15-2 for Punchestown bow, keen and went into clear lead before weakening to be beaten 24l

runners.name: Loughtown
runners.spotlight: 100-1 when last in a Naas bumper in December.
runners.comment: 100-1 when last in a Naas bumper in December

runners.name: Land Of The Giants
runners.spotlight: Mostly running well this year; won at Ayr in May off 63 (1m, gd-fm) and not beaten far the last twice; 4l third of 10 in a 1m Dundalk claimer on penultimate and beaten 2.25l in Down Royal handicap latest; in the mix.
runners.comment: Won at Ayr in May, respectable runs the last twice inc' in Dundalk claimer, in the mix
runners.owner: Mark Devlin & Nigel O'Hare & Philip Smith & Bart O'Sullivan

runners.name: Gloriously Glam
runners.spotlight: Below best in handicaps on last two starts; solid form in claiming company (form figures of 3113); handles most ground and went close over C&D on her only previous visit in October; big player.
runners.comment: Form figures in claimers read 3113, ground versatile, has gone well here before, player
runners.owner: Dooley Thoroughbreds & J Fairhurst & Deepak Dhand

runners.name: Smithfield
runners.spotlight: 0-8 and rated 64; runner up on debut in a Galway Festival maiden last August but failed to trouble the judge since; no improvement for cheekpieces latest; blinkers tried now.
runners.comment: 0-8, runner up on debut but failed to trouble judge since, blinkers replace cheekpieces

runners.name: Je Suis Celebre
runners.spotlight: Promise in AW maidens in Britain and on debut for this yard in February but failed to make any impact in two handicap runs on turf at Limerick (1m, yielding) and Fairyhouse (1m2f, good); can only be watched unless the market speaks.
runners.comment: Promise in AW maidens, no show in two turf handicaps, watch unless market speaks

runners.name: Minaun View
runners.spotlight: Maiden has run some decent races in defeat this season, including when a close second off 63 in a Down Royal handicap (7f, soft) two weeks ago; effective on good ground so dangerous to dismiss on first try in claiming company but needs to rebound from below par Fairyhouse run on Wednesday.
runners.comment: Maiden, poor at Fairyhouse on Wednesday, can't discount on first run in claiming company

runners.name: Hexagonal
runners.spotlight: Maiden produced back-to-back solid runs at Ballinrobe and the Curragh earlier this season; below that level the last twice and drops into claiming company for the first time; yard does well in these races (39-332) so not discounted.
runners.comment: Below best after promising runs at Ballinrobe and the Curragh, yard does well in claimers

runners.name: Alex Belardo
runners.spotlight: Generally consistent sort gained a second handicap win at Down Royal (7f, soft) two weeks ago off 58; in form but most of best turf form is on softer ground so probably needs rain.
runners.comment: Gained second h'cap win at Down Royal latest, best form on soft ground, may need rain

runners.name: Colugo
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose maiden; multiple placed efforts on the AW but 0-7 on turf and yet to trouble the judge; heavy defeat back on the Flat at Leopardstown on latest; others preferred.
runners.comment: Placed on AW but 0-7 on turf and yet to trouble the judge, others preferred

runners.name: Buttermere Ridge
runners.spotlight: Rated 68 so well treated by race conditions on paper and one of best efforts for this yard when beaten 6.5l into seventh of 15 in Leopardstown handicap (7f, good) on seasonal return; needs to back that up now.
runners.comment: One of best efforts for this yard in Leopardstown handicap latest, must build on that

runners.name: Dynamic Force
runners.spotlight: Locally trained; ran well over 7f at Down Royal on penultimate when a 1.75l fourth; midfield over an inadequate 6f at Fairyhouse last month; return to 1m a plus and last win came in a 1m Killarney claimer in 2024; fourth 6.10 here on Thursday.
runners.comment: Ran well on penultimate over 7f, 6f too sharp at Fairyhouse, won last start in claimer

runners.name: Tara Na Ri
runners.spotlight: One of best efforts yet on latest when fifth at Fairyhouse (1m2f, good) but was still beaten 9l off a mark of 57; more needed; due to run 5.40 Fairyhouse on Wednesday.
runners.comment: One of better efforts at Fairyhouse on latest but still beaten 9l, more needed

runners.name: Lohengrin
runners.spotlight: Sole success came on the beach at Laytown last September; lost way since but minor step in the right direction when beaten 6l in midfield at Leopardstown last time; has run well in claiming company before; could outrun odds for local yard.
runners.comment: Laytown maiden winner, lost way since but a bit better on latest, may outrun odds

runners.name: Wonderwalk
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; dual-purpose maiden; yet to trouble the judge in either code; rated 34 and leap of faith required to fancy her here.
runners.comment: Dual-purpose maiden, rated just 34 on the Flat, leap of faith required; reserve

runners.name: Rampage
runners.spotlight: Four-time winner; out of form recently and hasn't scored on turf since September 2023 but plenty of placed efforts to his name over this C&D so has to be respected on first run in claiming company with promising rider taking off 7lb; unplaced 6.10 here on Thursday.
runners.comment: No win on turf since 2023, plenty of placed efforts over C&D, respected
runners.owner: Mrs P McCourt/Whyte's Stamullen Syndicate/S Sweeney

runners.name: Annacroft
runners.spotlight: 66-1 and tailed off in a 1m5f Down Royal maiden on debut 13 days ago; hard to fancy down in trip on the back of that tame effort.
runners.comment: 66-1 and tailed off over 1m5f at Down Royal, hard to fancy after that tame effort

runners.name: Countertop
runners.spotlight: No sign of winning potential in four maiden runs at 5f-8.5f on varying ground; can only be watched on return from 260 day absence.
runners.comment: No sign of winning potential in maidens, off 260 days, best watched

runners.name: Mullacash Buzz
runners.spotlight: First reserve; losing run on grass stretches back to 2022; decent run at Dundalk but didn't back it up returned to turf at Roscommon two runs ago; rated 40 and up against it here; third here last night.
runners.comment: No win on turf since 2022, rated just 40 and looks to be up against it here; reserve

races.race_name: Irish EBF Median Sires Series (C & G) Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Kraar
runners.spotlight: Much improved second time out when runner-up at Down Royal (7f, soft) where Full Volume was back in sixth; that form sets the standard here.
runners.comment: Improved second at Down Royal (soft) and that form sets the standard here

runners.name: Full Volume
runners.spotlight: Not friendless in the betting at 5-1 when beaten 3.5l at Down Royal (7f, soft) and getting upset in the stalls didn't help matters; open to improvement.
runners.comment: Beaten 3.5l at Down Royal and getting upset in the stalls didn't help matters

runners.name: Cudawudashuda
runners.spotlight: 15,000euros foal; half-brother to 5f winner Shoebox King (RPR 82); dam unplaced 6f-1m2f (71), half-sister to 5f Group 3 winner Came From The Dark; stable has won this race twice since 2021; market informative.
runners.comment: 15,000euros foal; half-brother to 5f winner Shoebox King (RPR 82); market informative

runners.name: Celestial Heights
runners.spotlight: First foal out of a 7f/10.6f AW winner (RPR 80); stable has a good 2yo in their ranks so market support could be significant.
runners.comment: Stable has a good 2yo in their ranks so market support could be significant

runners.name: Rock On Johnny
runners.spotlight: Second foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners Sir Thomas Gresham (Listed-placed 6f) and Agent Allison (Group-placed 6f 2yo); likely best watched unless betting suggests otherwise.
runners.comment: Second foal; dam unraced half-sister to two useful winners

runners.name: Pennsylvania Ave
runners.spotlight: 45,000gns breeze-up buy; sixth foal; half-brother to winners Claritudo (1m4f/1m6f; RPR 79) and See The Green (1m Flat, 77; 2m hurdle); dam Listed-placed 1m AW winner (94); he would command plenty of respect if at all strong in the betting.
runners.comment: 45,000gns 2yo; would command plenty of respect if at all strong in the betting

runners.name: Come On Noddy
runners.spotlight: Slowly away, behind throughout and beaten 46l at Navan (5f, good; 40-1).
runners.comment: Slowly away, behind throughout and beaten 46l at Navan (5f, good; 40-1)

runners.name: Supreme Act
runners.spotlight: Never in contention at Down Royal (7f, good) when behind Kraar and Full Volume.
runners.comment: Never in contention at Down Royal (7f, good) when behind Kraar and Full Volume

runners.name: High Morals
runners.spotlight: 90,000euros yearling who was sent off the 3-1 favourite for his debut at the Curragh (6f, good) but weakened tamely into eighth; likely capable of better given the apparent confidence behind him first time out.
runners.comment: 3-1f for his Curragh debut but weakened into eighth; no doubt capable of better

runners.name: Chico Guapo
runners.spotlight: Pretty much tailed off in his first two races and he's getting himself ready for handicaps.
runners.comment: Pretty much tailed off in his first two races and he's getting himself ready for handicaps

races.race_name: Smiths Of Drogheda Ford Classic Handicap

runners.name: Imnotleavinyou
runners.spotlight: Limerick winner who was a beaten favourite only two days later at Gowran off this 7lb higher mark and again failed to get involved at Fairyhouse on Wednesday.
runners.comment: Limerick winner three runs back but opposable on what he's done since

runners.name: Zipster
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner and 2lb beneath his last winning mark; beaten about 4l in his last two races at 1m1f so not in bad form and he might get a good pace to chase, which helps him.
runners.comment: Not in bad form and he might get a good pace to chase, which helps him

runners.name: Rockbury Lad
runners.spotlight: Record of 3-50 so hard to win with; will need to run well here on Thursday (6.10) to merit attention.
runners.comment: He will need to run well here on Thursday (6.10) to merit attention
runners.owner: P E Ryan & J G Shanahan

runners.name: Glamazon
runners.spotlight: Belatedly off the mark in a course maiden in May but has offered little in subsequent handicaps; exposed now and tries blinkers.
runners.comment: Struggled in handicaps since winning a maiden here in May; now exposed and tries blinkers

runners.name: Bucaneer's Spirit
runners.spotlight: Four-time winner who is in a consistent run of form and he got himself too far back when fourth of 16 at Leopardstown two weeks ago (1m, good); hard to discount.
runners.comment: Four-time winner who is in a consistent run of form; got too far back the last time

runners.name: Bay Of Dreams
runners.spotlight: Won twice for James Ferguson last year; finding her feet for new yard and was clear over 1f out before reeled in at Leopardstown (1m, good; Bucaneer's Spirit fourth); well drawn for one who likes to be up there; likely contender.
runners.comment: Won twice for James Ferguson last year; now finding her feet for new yard

runners.name: Darkdeserthighway
runners.spotlight: A close third at Dundalk last time (1m AW) where she often runs well and has won four times; thoroughly exposed now and only 1-22 on the grass.
runners.comment: Good run on the AW last time but exposed now and only 1-22 on the grass

runners.name: Kitty Bear
runners.spotlight: Keeping herself busy; came home strongly under Orla Tynan to win at Roscommon (7.5f, good) but went up 10lb for that and was only midfield at the Curragh, albeit over 6.5f that was probably too sharp; others might be better in.
runners.comment: Others might be better in after going up 10lb for his latest win at Roscommon
runners.owner: Charles Kerwin & Brendan Kerwin & Liam Kehoe

runners.name: Smaoineamh Sile
runners.spotlight: An 8yo mare with five wins from 45 starts; not in great form and another headgear switch.
runners.comment: An 8yo mare with five wins from 45 starts; not in much form and another headgear switch

runners.name: Comfort Line
runners.spotlight: A 9yo with ten wins on the board and arrives here in good form, last time overcoming a slow start to finish second at the Curragh (7f); won't mind returning to further and he's firmly in the mix.
runners.comment: A 9yo with ten wins on the board and arrives here in good form; firmly in the mix

runners.name: Lahore Da King
runners.spotlight: C&D winner on soft ground in April but that was off 6lb lower and he's struggled since.
runners.comment: C&D winner on soft ground in April but that was off 6lb lower and he's struggled since

runners.name: Variance
runners.spotlight: Makes handicap debut after an absence and was well beaten in a claimer on final start.
runners.comment: Makes handicap debut after an absence and was well beaten in a claimer on final start

runners.name: Gotta Catch'em All
runners.spotlight: Has finished second on six occasions during his winless 24-race career; he might drop lucky one day but he's not the percentage call.
runners.comment: 0-24, often placed; might drop lucky one day but he's not the percentage call
runners.owner: Mrs S Bury & Ralph Kelly & Odhran O'Neill & Thomas Cox

runners.name: Tariff
runners.spotlight: Minor form, including a 7f AW handicap; 8lb out of the weights on this stable debut.
runners.comment: Minor form, including a 7f AW handicap; 8lb out of the weights on this stable debut

runners.name: Free Solo
runners.spotlight: Multiple winner; on a good mark but hasn't been all that threatening this year and others appeal more.
runners.comment: On a good mark but hasn't been all that threatening this year and others appeal more

runners.name: Tradewinds
runners.spotlight: Modest run on debut at Navan (6f, good) but much better twice since when a 2l third at the Curragh (6f, gd-yld,) and a 5.5l second at Down Royal (5f, soft); the form of that Curragh run was boosted by Sirocco Sands at York last weekend; solid claims.
runners.comment: Modest debut but much better last twice, form of Curragh third boosted, solid claims

runners.name: April Mist
runners.spotlight: Promising introduction for this Cotai Glory filly when a 2.25l second of 8 in a Fillies' maiden at Naas (5f, good) 9 days ago; rider reported she was a little intimidated by the winner 2f out; should be more streetwise now and Keane takes over; big chance.
runners.comment: Promising introduction at Naas 9 days ago, Keane takes over now, big chance

runners.name: Alrashdeyah
runners.spotlight: Betrayed inexperience when green on debut at Cork (6f, soft); didn't fare much better on good ground at Fairyhouse on latest; worth a go at 5f and likely capable of better in first-time hood but Tradewinds looks yard's best chance.
runners.comment: Green on debut at Cork, not much better at Fairyhouse, Tradewinds looks yard's main hope

runners.name: Little Diva
runners.spotlight: Magna Grecia filly; E1,000 yearling; dam unraced half-sister to Listed winners Band Practice (5f 2yo) and Nice Name (Italian 1m), out of 5f/6f winner; likely best watched on debut for local yard.
runners.comment: Magna Grecia filly, dam unraced, likely best watched on debut for local yard

runners.name: Bold Commander
runners.spotlight: Well-bred No Nay Never colt was sent off at 6-1 on debut when looked yard's second string at Cork (6f, good) and was beaten 6.5l into fifth; the second and third from that race have won maidens since and the fourth ran well in the Chesham Stakes; dropping back to 5f looks a positive and he's likely to improve plenty for that initial experience.
runners.comment: Beaten 6.5l over 6f on debut at Cork, form has worked out, drop in trip a plus, go well
runners.owner: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor

runners.name: Two Brigade
runners.spotlight: Tailed off on testing ground at the Curragh on debut (5f); better effort on good ground at Naas (6f) in May when a 9l fifth of 7 behind Confucius; needs to improve again dropped back in trip.
runners.comment: Tailed off on heavy on debut, beaten 9l on good at Naas latest, needs to improve

runners.name: Howlin Wolf
runners.spotlight: Long odds for both starts and soundly beaten; second effort a bit better than his first but much more needed; will qualify for nurseries after this.
runners.comment: Long odds and no impact in first two starts, will qualify for nurseries after this

runners.name: New Mexico
runners.spotlight: Yard does well with juveniles but this Perfect Power colt finished well beaten in a pair of Curragh maidens over 5f and 6f on testing ground in April; needs to improve markedly for better ground and a gelding operation.
runners.comment: Gelded since two modest maiden runs on soft/heavy at the Curragh, must improve plenty
runners.owner: Giselle De Aguiar & AMO Racing Limited

runners.name: Sparky Sparky
runners.spotlight: Beaten six times but two of his runs read well in this company and last time was one of those, finishing second of 13 in a 5f maiden at Cork won by the odds-on favourite; big shout.
runners.comment: Six defeats but two of his runs read well in this company and last time was one of those

runners.name: White Smoke
runners.spotlight: Major form claims on her seconds in 6f maidens at the Curragh last season but she's threatening to go the wrong way this year (5f maiden/6f handicap); those two runs were in cheekpieces and now goes in a tongue-tie/blinkers combination.
runners.comment: Has dangerous form but threatening to go the wrong way; more new headgear

runners.name: Kidd
runners.spotlight: 2,000euros yearling; dam 5f winner (RPR 82) and half-sister to 7f winner Cill Mocheallog; can only be watched on what is a belated debut; has tongue tied.
runners.comment: 2,000euros yearling; dam 5f winner (RPR 82) and half-sister to 7f winner Cill Mocheallog

runners.name: Reposado
runners.spotlight: Three second this year include two in 6f handicaps at the Curragh; however, disappointing in last two races (5f maiden/7f handicap) and now 0-17; these terms aren't favourable, either.
runners.comment: Runs well now and again but 0-17 and these terms aren't favourable
runners.owner: AMO Racing Limited & Giselle De Aguiar

runners.name: Ennoble
runners.spotlight: Consistent RPRs in his first three races before a quiet final run last season; 5-1 for his return in a 5f maiden at Navan where he unseated early after stumbling; should be competitive in this company.
runners.comment: Three good runs last season; stumbled early and unseated when 5-1 on his return

runners.name: Banish Misfortune
runners.spotlight: 300-1 when tailed off in a 7f soft-ground maiden at Limerick two weeks ago.
runners.comment: 300-1 when tailed off in a 7f soft-ground maiden at Limerick two weeks ago

runners.name: Profit Surge
runners.spotlight: Near misses in two claimers during May extended her losing sequence to 16 so she's had plenty of chances now; rated only 62 so should be vulnerable again.
runners.comment: Near misses in two claimers during May extended her losing sequence to 16

runners.name: Focaccia
runners.spotlight: 0-5 and has yet to post a RPR higher than 68, so likely has quite a lot to find.
runners.comment: 0-5 and has yet to post a RPR higher than 68, so likely has quite a lot to find

runners.name: Steel Magnolia
runners.spotlight: May prefer slower ground but wasn't far behind Platino Bianco and Happy Henry last week at Naas and she's likeably consistent.
runners.comment: Not far behind Platino Bianco and Happy Henry last week at Naas and likeably consistent

runners.name: Viamonte
runners.spotlight: 13-race maiden who has threatened in maiden and handicap company but cheekpieces are now called for (replacing regular tongue-tie) in the hope of staging the revival that he needs; on a good mark, though.
runners.comment: 13-race maiden who is on a good mark if the new cheekpieces can trigger something

runners.name: Taylormade Lad
runners.spotlight: 1m3f win at Carlisle (good to firm) last summer; began his 2026 campaign with two solid efforts but his form dipped at Carlisle 24 days ago (Class 5; sent off favourite); has to enter calculations at this modest level.
runners.comment: Drops in class and holds solid claims on this year's best efforts

runners.name: Speechman
runners.spotlight: Two AW wins in France but little to celebrate in Britain; two AW runs last autumn were respectable but nothing comparable this year; the new headgear needs to prove transformative.
runners.comment: Struggled this year and yet to win on turf; new headgear not enough to tempt

races.race_name: Ire-Incentive, It Pays To Buy Irish EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Viking Barbie
runners.spotlight: She has improved with each of her three runs in novice company, most recently finishing second of nine at Sandown (5f, good) three weeks ago; should go well.
runners.comment: Improving run by run and likely capable of better; one to take seriously

runners.name: Eevee Star
runners.spotlight: Shaped well when third of eight at Ripon (6f, good) on her debut in May; failed to build on it on slower ground at Carlisle last month; not tried in a tongue-tie but needs to improve to trouble the principals.
runners.comment: Debut run (6f, good) was promising; backward step on slower going latest; now tongue tied

runners.name: Miss Havisham
runners.spotlight: 400,000gns yearling; weak 7-2 shot when a remote third of four at Carlisle (5f, good; first two home useful fillies) in May; can do better.
runners.comment: Well-beaten 3rd behind two useful fillies on debut; this 400,000gns yearling can improve
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

runners.name: Nightbloom
runners.spotlight: 400,000euros yearling; sixth foal; closely related to 5f/6f winner Rogue Lightning (including 2yo/Listed/Qatar; RPR 115), half-sister to two winners including Sixtygeesbaby (6f including 2yo; 92); dam 6f AW 2yo winner (84), half-sister to useful 5f/6f winner Pennsylvania Dutch; looks the part on paper.
runners.comment: 400,000euros yearling; lots to like on paper and she's one to take seriously

runners.name: Tropical Crown
runners.spotlight: 45,000gns yearling, £100,000 breeze-up 2yo; sixth foal; half-sister to four winners including Spirit Of Nguru (7f AW 2yo; RPR 95), Blue Nguru (5f AW 2yo; 70) and Rastafara (US 1m turf); dam Listed-placed 6f 2yo winner (98); likely type on paper and trainer took this race in 2019, 2021 and 2023 (all three winners had experience).
runners.comment: £100,000 breeze-up 2yo; likely type on paper for yard that won this in 2019, 2021 and 2023

runners.name: Northern Viola
runners.spotlight: She has recorded an RPR in the 50s in finishing fifth in 7f events at Wetherby (fillies' maiden) and Musselburgh (seller); nurseries more suitable after this.
runners.comment: Just minor promise in two 7f runs last month; nurseries beckon

runners.name: Isca Bay
runners.spotlight: 22-1 for her recent debut at Windsor (6f, good to firm) and showed some promise in finishing a 6l fifth of the 13 runners; can do better but such progress is essential in this field.
runners.comment: 22-1 for debut (6f, good to firm) 11 days ago and shaped okay; plenty more needed here

races.race_name: Belazu, Part Of The William Jackson Food Group Handicap

runners.name: I'm Next
runners.spotlight: Began his campaign with a second and first over C&D in April; his progress has continued, adding a win at Redcar (5f, good) 13 days ago; well drawn for a prominent racer and should go well despite his career-high mark.
runners.comment: Improving sprinter with formfigures of 321 over C&D; well drawn to attack; contender.

runners.name: Mon Na Slieve
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer; on a good mark and his latest Hamilton third offered hope he would be adding to his tally soon; tongue-tie returns today; considered.
runners.comment: On a dangerous mark and he ran well last week; tongue-tie returns; chance

runners.name: Hundred Caps
runners.spotlight: In good form on AW earlier in the year; unplaced both starts since returning to turf this summer and others have stronger claims.
runners.comment: C&D winner; in good form on AW this year but recent turf efforts need bettering

runners.name: Tiva
runners.spotlight: Running creditably this season and she is closely matched with Elegant Erin on their Nottingham run 13 days ago; suspicion she is vulnerable again here though; cheekpieces replace a visor today.
runners.comment: Closely matched with Elegant Erin on recent run but suspicion she will be vulnerable again

runners.name: Emperor Spirit
runners.spotlight: Blows hot and cold but he is on a dangerous mark and his second of 17 at Ascot (5f, good to firm) in May was a fine effort; subsequent run in the Dash at Epsom can be forgiven (ground) and this should be more to his liking; other pace influences on show.
runners.comment: Ground excuse at Epsom last time; earlier Ascot second was a fine run; not ruled out

runners.name: Master Of My Fate
runners.spotlight: Added another two AW wins to his tally earlier in the year; unplaced in three runs back on turf but dropping back into a Class 4 should help; others preferred all the same.
runners.comment: Two AW wins this year; quiet on turf since but now drops back into a Class 4
runners.owner: Ms Janelle Cao, Ross Harmon & Partner

runners.name: Duran
runners.spotlight: Made a promising return to action over C&D in April but two runs since have been underwhelming; drawn widest and hopes rest on the new visor having a positive effect.
runners.comment: Well handicapped but quiet since promising reappearance; drawn wide; now tried in a visor
runners.owner: D Caslin, P Wilcock & M Cantillon

runners.name: Managing Director
runners.spotlight: Made all to win a 5f nursery at Thirsk for Bryan Smart in September 2024; soft-ground defeat one month later easy enough to forgive; been gelded since last seen; 630-day absence the obvious negative now starting out for a new yard (same owner).
runners.comment: Unexposed 4yo but the 630-day absence is an obvious concern; been gelded

runners.name: Elegant Erin
runners.spotlight: Five wins and a second from nine attempts over C&D; ended 2025 in flying form and returned off a brutal mark as a consequence; handicapper relenting now and her third at Nottingham 13 days ago was a step back in the right direction; this should be run to suit and she's a strong contender.
runners.comment: Fine C&D record; back to more manageable mark and latest 3rd was promising; strong chance

runners.name: Nepal
runners.spotlight: Two wins for George Scott (1m2f and 1m4f, both good to firm) and he recorded an RPR of 85 in Bahrain on his penultimate start; had a wind op prior to this stable debut; cheekpieces return.
runners.comment: 1m2f/1m4f wins for George Scott; had wind op prior to stable debut; big drop in class

runners.name: Midnight Strike
runners.spotlight: Useful performer for Joseph O'Brien but struggling for new yard in 2026, albeit last week's York eighth was better; accessories now go on; favoured by the weights.
runners.comment: Struggling for new yard but last week's York run was better; accessories now added
runners.owner: James Paul Services To Industry Ltd

runners.name: Catton Lady
runners.spotlight: Infrequent winner; fair return to action when fifth over C&D in April but she looks to face an uphill task at these weights.
runners.comment: Fair fifth over C&D in April but she looks to face a tough task at the weights
runners.owner: W H & Mrs J A Tinning & Mrs C Wallis

runners.name: Blufferonthebus
runners.spotlight: Won twice over 7f last November; comparable form when second at Carlisle (1m, soft) last month; not so good last time and she faces a stiff task at the weights; slower ground ideal too.
runners.comment: The odd good run this year but faces stiff task at the weights and slower ground preferred

runners.name: Hatamoto
runners.spotlight: Placed in three of his four handicap runs this year, the latest when second at Ripon (1m, good) two weeks ago; major player in a race lacking depth.
runners.comment: Placed in three of his four handicap runs this year; leading claims in this field

runners.name: Mali Star
runners.spotlight: Two placed efforts to start this campaign (1m, good and firm); backward step over 1m2f (cheekpieces tried) four weeks ago; has left Jack Channon and new stable quick to discard headgear; betting useful.
runners.comment: Chance on best form for Jack Channon; betting should guide
runners.owner: C Ward, B Kirby, Mrs R Carr

runners.name: Regal Knight
runners.spotlight: Unplaced in all seven starts, the latest when just 5-1 for a 1m handicap at Ripon two weeks ago; now tried in blinkers; stable run two.
runners.comment: Poor form in seven runs, including when backed last time; stable run two
runners.owner: D Bishop P Robinson S Bland T Coyle

runners.name: Amber Hamur
runners.spotlight: Didn't live up to market billing in two handicap runs for George Boughey this year; new stable quick to step her up in trip and she's an interesting contender.
runners.comment: Prominent in the betting in two handicaps but not progressed; up in trip for stable debut

runners.name: Eva The Deeva
runners.spotlight: No immediate improvement for the switch to handicaps when seventh of nine at Ripon (1m, good) five weeks ago; early days but  she needs a transformation.
runners.comment: No improvement for the switch to handicaps at Ripon five weeks ago; enough to prove

runners.name: Itszaboy
runners.spotlight: Big prices and well beaten in two handicaps this year; dropping down the weights but hard to recommend.
runners.comment: Well beaten in two handicaps this year; not easily recommended

runners.name: Ten Sixty Six
runners.spotlight: Hit the frame in her first three 2yo starts; struggled in handicaps this time around and risky despite her mark dropping in chunks.
runners.comment: Not matched 2yo form in handicaps this year; mark in freefall but not a solid option

runners.name: Singarda
runners.spotlight: Tried a few trips this year and hasn't looked well handicapped at any of them; continues to drop in the weights and the addition of cheekpieces could give him a lift.
runners.comment: No real impact in handicaps (7f-1m3f) this year; down in weights and tried in cheekpieces
runners.owner: D Bishop, S Bland & T Coyle

runners.name: The Sweet Escape
runners.spotlight: Consistent since his Nottingham win in April (good) and latest race at Hamilton for which he was favourite didn't go to plan; ideally wants further, however.
runners.comment: Consistent this season and last race didn't go to plan; ideally wants further, though

runners.name: King Sharja
runners.spotlight: Solid enough runs in his last three starts, all over 7f; all three turf wins have come here, the latest a year ago off this mark; chance.
runners.comment: All three turf wins have come here, the latest a year ago off this mark; running well

runners.name: Tropez Power
runners.spotlight: Won on turf in 2021 and his last AW win was in April 2024; on a career-low mark but ran moderately last time.
runners.comment: Only turf win was in 2021; on a career-low mark but ran moderately last time

runners.name: Sir David
runners.spotlight: 7f winner last August on good ground off 6lb higher so has to be of interest after returning to form with a second at Carlisle (7f, soft), which was his best run yet for this yard.
runners.comment: A winner last term off 6lb higher so has to be of interest after latest return to form

runners.name: Sunny Orange
runners.spotlight: Four of his five wins have been at Beverley and they include this race 12 months ago; only fourth of six here ten days back but that was a Class 5.
runners.comment: Last year's winner; fourth of six here ten days ago but that was a Class 5

runners.name: Reginald Charles
runners.spotlight: Three AW wins and 0-18 on turf after finishing second to Travis at Redcar; the winner comfortably had his measure but a 5lb pull could make it interesting.
runners.comment: No match for Travis at Redcar but a 5lb pull could make it interesting

runners.name: Qazaq
runners.spotlight: On a long losing run as he's winless since 2024; ran okay in a new hood/cheekpieces combination at Musselburgh but has another change of headgear now; others probably safer.
runners.comment: Third last time but in another change of headgear others are probably safer

runners.name: Jesmond Dawn
runners.spotlight: Only 3-34; a well-held third behind Travis and Reginald Charles at Redcar where he was beaten by the track bias; off the same mark he should make his presence felt.
runners.comment: Beaten by the track bias at Redcar last time and can make presence felt off same mark

runners.name: Travis
runners.spotlight: Back to form with a 20-1 win at Redcar where he and runner-up Reginald Charles benefited from racing alone; did that comfortably and a 6lb rise wouldn't be too troublesome if he has turned a corner.
runners.comment: Back to form with a 20-1 win at Redcar; back up 6lb but he may have turned a corner

runners.name: Electric Lightning
runners.spotlight: Off the same mark as for his sole win last summer, over 1m at Doncaster; however, this season hasn't started at all well.
runners.comment: Won over 1m last summer but this season hasn't started at all well

runners.name: Dr Rio
runners.spotlight: Loves it here and he's fine from this trip up to 1m4f; placed over the extended 1m here in May before finding the ground too slow at Carlisle; a wide draw isn't ideal, though.
runners.comment: Loves it here and he's fine from this trip up to 1m4f; ground was too slow last time
